text.KJV: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
text.ASV: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
text.WEB: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

text.KJV: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
text.ASV: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
text.WEB: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

text.KJV: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
text.ASV: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
text.WEB: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

text.KJV: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
text.ASV: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
text.WEB: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

text.KJV: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
text.ASV: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
text.WEB: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

text.KJV: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
text.ASV: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
text.WEB: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

text.KJV: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
text.ASV: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
text.WEB: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

text.KJV: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
text.ASV: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
text.WEB: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

text.KJV: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
text.ASV: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
text.WEB: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.

text.KJV: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
text.ASV: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
text.WEB: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

text.KJV: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
text.ASV: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, `and' fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.
text.WEB: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth”; and it was so.

text.KJV: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
text.ASV: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.
text.WEB: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

text.KJV: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
text.ASV: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
text.WEB: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

text.KJV: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
text.ASV: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:
text.WEB: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

text.KJV: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
text.ASV: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
text.WEB: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth”; and it was so.

text.KJV: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
text.ASV: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: `he made' the stars also.
text.WEB: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

text.KJV: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
text.ASV: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,
text.WEB: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

text.KJV: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
text.ASV: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
text.WEB: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

text.KJV: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
text.ASV: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
text.WEB: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

text.KJV: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
text.ASV: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
text.WEB: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

text.KJV: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
text.ASV: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
text.WEB: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

text.KJV: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
text.ASV: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
text.WEB: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

text.KJV: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
text.ASV: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
text.WEB: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

text.KJV: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
text.ASV: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.
text.WEB: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind”; and it was so.

text.KJV: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
text.ASV: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
text.WEB: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

text.KJV: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
text.ASV: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
text.WEB: God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

text.KJV: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
text.ASV: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
text.WEB: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

text.KJV: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
text.ASV: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
text.WEB: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

text.KJV: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
text.ASV: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:
text.WEB: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

text.KJV: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
text.ASV: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, `I have given' every green herb for food: and it was so.
text.WEB: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

text.KJV: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
text.ASV: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
text.WEB: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

text.KJV: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
text.ASV: And the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
text.WEB: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

text.KJV: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
text.ASV: And on the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
text.WEB: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

text.KJV: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
text.ASV: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it he rested from all his work which God had created and made.
text.WEB: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

text.KJV: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
text.ASV: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Jehovah God made earth and heaven.
text.WEB: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made the earth and the heavens.

text.KJV: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
text.ASV: And no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Jehovah God had not caused it to rain upon the earth: and there was not a man to till the ground;
text.WEB: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

text.KJV: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
text.ASV: but there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
text.WEB: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

text.KJV: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
text.ASV: And Jehovah God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
text.WEB: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

text.KJV: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
text.ASV: And Jehovah God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
text.WEB: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

text.KJV: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
text.ASV: And out of the ground made Jehovah God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
text.WEB: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

text.KJV: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
text.ASV: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.
text.WEB: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

text.KJV: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
text.ASV: The name of the first is Pishon: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
text.WEB: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

text.KJV: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
text.ASV: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
text.WEB: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

text.KJV: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
text.ASV: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.
text.WEB: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

text.KJV: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
text.ASV: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth in front of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
text.WEB: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

text.KJV: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
text.ASV: And Jehovah God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
text.WEB: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

text.KJV: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
text.ASV: And Jehovah God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
text.WEB: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

text.KJV: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
text.ASV: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
text.WEB: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

text.KJV: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
text.ASV: And Jehovah God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.
text.WEB: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

text.KJV: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
text.ASV: And out of the ground Jehovah God formed every beast of the field, and every bird of the heavens; and brought them unto the man to see what he would call them: and whatsoever the man called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
text.WEB: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

text.KJV: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
text.ASV: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the birds of the heavens, and to every beast of the field; but for man there was not found a help meet for him.
text.WEB: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

text.KJV: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
text.ASV: And Jehovah God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof:
text.WEB: Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

text.KJV: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
text.ASV: and the rib, which Jehovah God had taken from the man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
text.WEB: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

text.KJV: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
text.ASV: And the man said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
text.WEB: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

text.KJV: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
text.ASV: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
text.WEB: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

text.KJV: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
text.ASV: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
text.WEB: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

text.KJV: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
text.ASV: Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which Jehovah God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of any tree of the garden?
text.WEB: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden?’”

text.KJV: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
text.ASV: And the woman said unto the serpent, Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat:
text.WEB: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

text.KJV: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
text.ASV: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
text.WEB: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

text.KJV: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
text.ASV: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
text.WEB: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

text.KJV: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
text.ASV: for God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as God, knowing good and evil.
text.WEB: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

text.KJV: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
text.ASV: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat; and she gave also unto her husband with her, and he did eat.
text.WEB: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate; and she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

text.KJV: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
text.ASV: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig-leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
text.WEB: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

text.KJV: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
text.ASV: And they heard the voice of Jehovah God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Jehovah God amongst the trees of the garden.
text.WEB: They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

text.KJV: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
text.ASV: And Jehovah God called unto the man, and said unto him, Where art thou?
text.WEB: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

text.KJV: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
text.ASV: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
text.WEB: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”

text.KJV: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
text.ASV: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
text.WEB: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

text.KJV: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
text.ASV: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
text.WEB: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

text.KJV: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
text.ASV: And Jehovah God said unto the woman, What is this thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
text.WEB: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

text.KJV: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
text.ASV: And Jehovah God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, cursed art thou above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
text.WEB: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

text.KJV: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
text.ASV: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed: he shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
text.WEB: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

text.KJV: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
text.ASV: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy pain and thy conception; in pain thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
text.WEB: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. In pain you will bear children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

text.KJV: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
text.ASV: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in toil shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
text.WEB: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and ate from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

text.KJV: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
text.ASV: thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
text.WEB: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

text.KJV: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
text.ASV: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
text.WEB: By the sweat of your face will you eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For you are dust, and to dust you shall return.”

text.KJV: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
text.ASV: And the man called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
text.WEB: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

text.KJV: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
text.ASV: And Jehovah God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins, and clothed them.
text.WEB: Yahweh God made coats of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

text.KJV: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
text.ASV: And Jehovah God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever-
text.WEB: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

text.KJV: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
text.ASV: therefore Jehovah God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
text.WEB: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

text.KJV: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
text.ASV: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden the Cherubim, and the flame of a sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
text.WEB: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

text.KJV: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
text.ASV: And the man knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man with `the help of' Jehovah.
text.WEB: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”

text.KJV: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
text.ASV: And again she bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
text.WEB: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

text.KJV: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.

text.KJV: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
text.ASV: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Jehovah had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
text.WEB: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,

text.KJV: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
text.ASV: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
text.WEB: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

text.KJV: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
text.ASV: If thou doest well, shall it not be lifted up? and if thou doest not well, sin coucheth at the door: and unto thee shall be its desire, but do thou rule over it.
text.WEB: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

text.KJV: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
text.ASV: And Cain told Abel his brother. And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
text.WEB: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: am I my brother's keeper?
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

text.KJV: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
text.ASV: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

text.KJV: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
text.ASV: And now cursed art thou from the ground, which hath opened its mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
text.WEB: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

text.KJV: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
text.ASV: when thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee its strength; a fugitive and a wanderer shalt thou be in the earth.
text.WEB: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”

text.KJV: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
text.ASV: And Cain said unto Jehovah, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
text.WEB: Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

text.KJV: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
text.ASV: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the ground; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth; and it will come to pass, that whosoever findeth me will slay me.
text.WEB: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And Jehovah appointed a sign for Cain, lest any finding him should smite him.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

text.KJV: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
text.ASV: And Cain went out from the presence of Jehovah, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
text.WEB: Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

text.KJV: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
text.ASV: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
text.WEB: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

text.KJV: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
text.ASV: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methushael; and Methushael begat Lamech.
text.WEB: To Enoch was born Irad. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

text.KJV: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
text.ASV: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
text.WEB: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

text.KJV: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
text.ASV: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents and `have' cattle.
text.WEB: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

text.KJV: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
text.ASV: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and pipe.
text.WEB: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

text.KJV: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
text.ASV: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
text.WEB: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

text.KJV: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
text.ASV: And Lamech said unto his wives: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: For I have slain a man for wounding me, And a young man for bruising me:
text.WEB: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

text.KJV: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
text.ASV: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
text.WEB: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

text.KJV: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
text.ASV: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth. For, `said she', God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.
text.WEB: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

text.KJV: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enosh. Then began men to call upon the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
text.ASV: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
text.WEB: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

text.KJV: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
text.ASV: male and female created he them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
text.WEB: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them “Adam”.

text.KJV: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, and after his image; and called his name Seth:
text.ASV: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begat `a son' in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
text.WEB: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

text.KJV: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and the days of Adam after he begat Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
text.ASV: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
text.WEB: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
text.ASV: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begat Enosh:
text.WEB: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

text.KJV: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and Seth lived after he begat Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
text.ASV: and all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
text.WEB: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
text.ASV: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begat Kenan.
text.WEB: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

text.KJV: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and Enosh lived after he begat Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
text.ASV: and all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
text.WEB: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Cainan lived seventy years and begat Mahalaleel:
text.ASV: And Kenan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalalel:
text.WEB: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

text.KJV: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and Kenan lived after he begat Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

text.KJV: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
text.ASV: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
text.WEB: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
text.ASV: And Mahalalel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
text.WEB: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

text.KJV: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: And Mahalalel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
text.ASV: and all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
text.WEB: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
text.ASV: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and begat Enoch:
text.WEB: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

text.KJV: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
text.ASV: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
text.WEB: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
text.ASV: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
text.WEB: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

text.KJV: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
text.ASV: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
text.WEB: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

text.KJV: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
text.ASV: and Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
text.WEB: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

text.KJV: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech.
text.ASV: And Methuselah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
text.WEB: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

text.KJV: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: and Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
text.ASV: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
text.WEB: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
text.ASV: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
text.WEB: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

text.KJV: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
text.ASV: and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, `which cometh' because of the ground which Jehovah hath cursed.
text.WEB: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

text.KJV: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.ASV: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
text.WEB: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
text.ASV: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
text.WEB: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

text.KJV: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text.ASV: And Noah was five hundred years old: And Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text.WEB: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters were born unto them,
text.WEB: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

text.KJV: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
text.ASV: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all that they chose.
text.WEB: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

text.KJV: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, My spirit shall not strive with man for ever, for that he also is flesh: yet shall his days be a hundred and twenty years.
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

text.KJV: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
text.ASV: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of God came unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them: the same were the mighty men that were of old, the men of renown.
text.WEB: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

text.KJV: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
text.ASV: And Jehovah saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
text.WEB: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

text.KJV: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
text.ASV: And it repented Jehovah that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
text.WEB: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

text.KJV: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the ground; both man, and beast, and creeping things, and birds of the heavens; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

text.KJV: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
text.ASV: But Noah found favor in the eyes of Jehovah.
text.WEB: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

text.KJV: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
text.ASV: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, `and' perfect in his generations: Noah walked with God.
text.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

text.KJV: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text.ASV: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text.WEB: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

text.KJV: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
text.ASV: And the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
text.WEB: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

text.KJV: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
text.ASV: And God saw the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way upon the earth.
text.WEB: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

text.KJV: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
text.ASV: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
text.WEB: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

text.KJV: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
text.ASV: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
text.WEB: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

text.KJV: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
text.ASV: And this is how thou shalt make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
text.WEB: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

text.KJV: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
text.ASV: A light shalt thou make to the ark, and to a cubit shalt thou finish it upward; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
text.WEB: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

text.KJV: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
text.ASV: And I, behold, I do bring the flood of waters upon this earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is in the earth shall die.
text.WEB: I, even I, do bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

text.KJV: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
text.ASV: But I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
text.WEB: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

text.KJV: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
text.ASV: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
text.WEB: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

text.KJV: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
text.ASV: Of the birds after their kind, and of the cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
text.WEB: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

text.KJV: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
text.ASV: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
text.WEB: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

text.KJV: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
text.ASV: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
text.WEB: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

text.KJV: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
text.ASV: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee seven and seven, the male and his female; and of the beasts that are not clean two, the male and his female:
text.WEB: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

text.KJV: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
text.ASV: of the birds also of the heavens, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
text.WEB: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

text.KJV: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
text.ASV: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living thing that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the ground.
text.WEB: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

text.KJV: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
text.ASV: And Noah did according unto all that Jehovah commanded him.
text.WEB: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

text.KJV: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
text.ASV: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
text.WEB: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

text.KJV: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
text.ASV: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
text.WEB: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

text.KJV: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
text.ASV: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creepeth upon the ground,
text.WEB: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

text.KJV: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
text.ASV: there went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
text.WEB: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
text.ASV: And it came to pass after the seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
text.WEB: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

text.KJV: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
text.ASV: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
text.WEB: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

text.KJV: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
text.ASV: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
text.WEB: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

text.KJV: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
text.ASV: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
text.WEB: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

text.KJV: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
text.ASV: they, and every beast after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
text.WEB: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

text.KJV: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
text.ASV: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh wherein is the breath of life.
text.WEB: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

text.KJV: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
text.ASV: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him: and Jehovah shut him in.
text.WEB: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

text.KJV: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
text.ASV: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lifted up above the earth.
text.WEB: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

text.KJV: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
text.ASV: And the waters prevailed, and increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
text.WEB: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

text.KJV: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
text.ASV: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high mountains that were under the whole heaven were covered.
text.WEB: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

text.KJV: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
text.ASV: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
text.WEB: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

text.KJV: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
text.ASV: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both birds, and cattle, and beasts, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
text.WEB: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

text.KJV: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
text.ASV: all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, of all that was on the dry land, died.
text.WEB: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

text.KJV: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
text.ASV: And every living thing was destroyed that was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and creeping things, and birds of the heavens; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only was left, and they that were with him in the ark.
text.WEB: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

text.KJV: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
text.ASV: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.
text.WEB: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

text.KJV: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged;
text.ASV: And God remembered Noah, and all the beasts, and all the cattle that were with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged;
text.WEB: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

text.KJV: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
text.ASV: the fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
text.WEB: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

text.KJV: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
text.ASV: and the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.
text.WEB: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters decreased.

text.KJV: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
text.ASV: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
text.WEB: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

text.KJV: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
text.ASV: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
text.WEB: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

text.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
text.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
text.WEB: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

text.KJV: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
text.ASV: and he sent forth a raven, and it went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
text.WEB: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

text.KJV: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
text.ASV: And he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
text.WEB: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

text.KJV: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
text.ASV: but the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him to the ark; for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: and he put forth his hand, and took her, and brought her in unto him into the ark.
text.WEB: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

text.KJV: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
text.ASV: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
text.WEB: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

text.KJV: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
text.ASV: and the dove came in to him at eventide; and, lo, in her mouth an olive-leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
text.WEB: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

text.KJV: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
text.ASV: And he stayed yet other seven days, and sent forth the dove; and she returned not again unto him any more.
text.WEB: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him anymore.

text.KJV: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dried.
text.WEB: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.

text.KJV: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
text.ASV: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dry.
text.WEB: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

text.KJV: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
text.ASV: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
text.WEB: God spoke to Noah, saying,

text.KJV: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
text.ASV: Go forth from the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
text.WEB: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

text.KJV: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
text.ASV: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee of all flesh, both birds, and cattle, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
text.WEB: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

text.KJV: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
text.ASV: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
text.WEB: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

text.KJV: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
text.ASV: every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatsoever moveth upon the earth, after their families, went forth out of the ark.
text.WEB: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
