text.KJV: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
text.ASV: And Noah builded an altar unto Jehovah, and took of every clean beast, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt-offerings on the altar.
text.WEB: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

text.KJV: And the LORD smelled a sweet savor; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
text.ASV: And Jehovah smelled the sweet savor; and Jehovah said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake, for that the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more everything living, as I have done.
text.WEB: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

text.KJV: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
text.ASV: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
text.WEB: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

text.KJV: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
text.ASV: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
text.WEB: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

text.KJV: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
text.ASV: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every bird of the heavens; With all wherewith the ground teemeth, and all the fishes of the sea, into your hand are they delivered.
text.WEB: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

text.KJV: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
text.ASV: Every moving thing that liveth shall be food for you; As the green herb have I given you all.
text.WEB: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

text.KJV: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
text.ASV: But flesh with the life thereof, `which is' the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
text.WEB: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

text.KJV: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
text.ASV: And surely your blood, `the blood' of your lives, will I require; At the hand of every beast will I require it. And at the hand of man, even at the hand of every man's brother, will I require the life of man.
text.WEB: I will surely require your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

text.KJV: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
text.ASV: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: For in the image of God made he man.
text.WEB: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

text.KJV: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
text.ASV: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; Bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
text.WEB: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

text.KJV: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
text.ASV: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
text.WEB: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

text.KJV: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
text.ASV: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
text.WEB: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

text.KJV: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
text.ASV: and with every living creature that is with you, the birds, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you. Of all that go out of the ark, even every beast of the earth.
text.WEB: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

text.KJV: And I will establish my covenant with you, neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
text.ASV: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
text.WEB: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

text.KJV: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
text.ASV: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
text.WEB: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

text.KJV: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
text.ASV: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
text.WEB: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud,
text.WEB: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

text.KJV: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
text.ASV: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
text.WEB: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

text.KJV: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
text.ASV: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
text.WEB: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

text.KJV: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
text.ASV: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
text.WEB: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

text.KJV: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
text.ASV: And the sons of Noah, that went forth from the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
text.WEB: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

text.KJV: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
text.ASV: These three were the sons of Noah: and of these was the whole earth overspread.
text.WEB: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.

text.KJV: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
text.ASV: And Noah began to be a husbandman, and planted a vineyard:
text.WEB: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

text.KJV: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
text.ASV: and he drank of the wine, and was drunken. And he was uncovered within his tent.
text.WEB: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

text.KJV: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
text.ASV: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
text.WEB: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

text.KJV: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
text.ASV: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father. And their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
text.WEB: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

text.KJV: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
text.ASV: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done unto him.
text.WEB: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

text.KJV: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
text.ASV: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
text.WEB: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

text.KJV: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
text.ASV: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.
text.WEB: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

text.KJV: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
text.ASV: God enlarge Japheth, And let him dwell in the tents of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.
text.WEB: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

text.KJV: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
text.ASV: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
text.WEB: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

text.KJV: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
text.ASV: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: And he died.
text.WEB: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

text.KJV: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
text.ASV: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, `namely', of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
text.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

text.KJV: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
text.ASV: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
text.WEB: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

text.KJV: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
text.ASV: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
text.WEB: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

text.KJV: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
text.ASV: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
text.WEB: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

text.KJV: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
text.ASV: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
text.WEB: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

text.KJV: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
text.ASV: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.
text.WEB: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

text.KJV: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
text.ASV: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
text.WEB: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

text.KJV: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
text.ASV: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
text.WEB: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

text.KJV: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
text.ASV: He was a mighty hunter before Jehovah: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Jehovah.
text.WEB: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

text.KJV: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
text.ASV: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
text.WEB: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

text.KJV: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
text.ASV: Out of that land he went forth into Assyria, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-ir, and Calah,
text.WEB: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

text.KJV: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
text.ASV: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).
text.WEB: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

text.KJV: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
text.ASV: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
text.WEB: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

text.KJV: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
text.ASV: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (whence went forth the Philistines), and Caphtorim.
text.WEB: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

text.KJV: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,
text.ASV: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,
text.WEB: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

text.KJV: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
text.ASV: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
text.WEB: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

text.KJV: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
text.ASV: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
text.WEB: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

text.KJV: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
text.ASV: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanite spread abroad.
text.WEB: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

text.KJV: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
text.ASV: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.
text.WEB: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
text.ASV: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

text.KJV: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
text.ASV: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.
text.WEB: Children were also born to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth.

text.KJV: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
text.ASV: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram.
text.WEB: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

text.KJV: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
text.ASV: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
text.WEB: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

text.KJV: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
text.ASV: And Arpachshad begat Shelah; and Shelah begat Eber.
text.WEB: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

text.KJV: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
text.ASV: And unto Eber were born two sons: The name of the one was Peleg. For in his days was the earth divided. And his brother's name was Joktan.
text.WEB: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

text.KJV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
text.ASV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
text.WEB: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

text.KJV: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
text.ASV: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
text.WEB: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

text.KJV: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
text.ASV: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
text.WEB: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

text.KJV: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
text.ASV: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
text.WEB: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

text.KJV: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
text.ASV: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
text.WEB: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
text.ASV: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

text.KJV: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
text.ASV: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
text.WEB: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.

text.KJV: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
text.ASV: And the whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
text.WEB: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as they journeyed east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
text.WEB: As they traveled from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

text.KJV: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.
text.ASV: And they said one to another, Come, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.
text.WEB: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

text.KJV: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
text.ASV: And they said, Come, let us build us a city, and a tower, whose top `may reach' unto heaven, and let us make us a name; lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
text.WEB: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

text.KJV: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
text.ASV: And Jehovah came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
text.WEB: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

text.KJV: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language; and this is what they begin to do: and now nothing will be withholden from them, which they purpose to do.
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

text.KJV: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
text.ASV: Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
text.WEB: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

text.KJV: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
text.ASV: So Jehovah scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off building the city.
text.WEB: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

text.KJV: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
text.ASV: Therefore was the name of it called Babel; because Jehovah did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did Jehovah scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
text.WEB: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

text.KJV: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
text.ASV: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old, and begat Arpachshad two years after the flood.
text.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

text.KJV: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Shem lived after he begat Arpachshad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
text.ASV: And Arpachshad lived five and thirty years, and begat Shelah.
text.WEB: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

text.KJV: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Arpachshad lived after he begat Shelah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
text.ASV: And Shelah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
text.WEB: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

text.KJV: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Shelah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
text.ASV: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
text.WEB: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

text.KJV: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
text.ASV: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
text.WEB: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

text.KJV: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
text.ASV: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
text.WEB: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

text.KJV: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
text.ASV: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
text.WEB: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

text.KJV: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
text.ASV: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
text.WEB: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

text.KJV: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.ASV: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
text.WEB: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

text.KJV: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
text.ASV: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
text.WEB: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

text.KJV: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
text.ASV: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran begat Lot.
text.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

text.KJV: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
text.ASV: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
text.WEB: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.

text.KJV: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
text.ASV: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: The name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
text.WEB: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.

text.KJV: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
text.ASV: And Sarai was barren; She had no child.
text.WEB: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

text.KJV: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
text.ASV: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, his son's son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
text.WEB: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

text.KJV: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
text.ASV: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
text.WEB: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

text.KJV: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will show thee:
text.ASV: Now Jehovah said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto the land that I will show thee:
text.WEB: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

text.KJV: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
text.ASV: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make they name great; and be thou a blessing;
text.WEB: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

text.KJV: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
text.ASV: and I will bless them that bless thee, and him that curseth thee will I curse: and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
text.WEB: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treates you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

text.KJV: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
text.ASV: So Abram went, as Jehovah had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
text.WEB: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

text.KJV: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
text.ASV: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
text.WEB: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
text.ASV: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem, unto the oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
text.WEB: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

text.KJV: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
text.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto Jehovah, who appeared unto him.
text.WEB: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who had appeared to him.

text.KJV: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: And he removed from thence unto the mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Ai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto Jehovah, and called upon the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
text.ASV: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.
text.WEB: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

text.KJV: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
text.ASV: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was sore in the land.
text.WEB: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
text.WEB: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

text.KJV: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
text.ASV: and it will come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they will say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
text.WEB: It will happen, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

text.KJV: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
text.ASV: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister; that it may be well with me for thy sake, and that my soul may live because of thee.
text.WEB: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
text.WEB: When Abram had come into Egypt, Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

text.KJV: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
text.ASV: And the princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
text.WEB: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

text.KJV: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
text.ASV: And he dealt well with Abram for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and men-servants, and maid-servants, and she-asses, and camels.
text.WEB: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

text.KJV: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
text.ASV: And Jehovah plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.
text.WEB: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
text.ASV: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
text.WEB: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

text.KJV: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
text.ASV: why saidst thou, She is my sister, so that I took her to be my wife? now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
text.WEB: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh gave men charge concerning him: and they brought him on the way, and his wife, and all that he had.
text.WEB: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

text.KJV: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
text.ASV: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the South.
text.WEB: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

text.KJV: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
text.ASV: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
text.WEB: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

text.KJV: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
text.ASV: And he went on his journeys from the South even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Ai,
text.WEB: He went on his journeys from the South even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

text.KJV: Unto the place of the altar, which he had make there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
text.ASV: And Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
text.WEB: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

text.KJV: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
text.ASV: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
text.WEB: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their substance was great, so that they could not live together.

text.KJV: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
text.ASV: And there was a strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelt then in the land.
text.WEB: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

text.KJV: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
text.ASV: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdsmen and thy herdsmen; for we are brethren.
text.WEB: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

text.KJV: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
text.ASV: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me. If `thou wilt take' the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if `thou take' the right hand, then I will go to the left.
text.WEB: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

text.KJV: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
text.ASV: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the Plain of the Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before Jehovah destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Jehovah, like the land of Egypt, as thou goest unto Zoar.
text.WEB: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

text.KJV: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
text.ASV: So Lot chose him all the Plain of the Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
text.WEB: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves the one from the other.

text.KJV: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
text.ASV: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the Plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
text.WEB: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

text.KJV: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
text.ASV: Now the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners against Jehovah exceedingly.
text.WEB: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art, northward and southward and eastward and westward:
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

text.KJV: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
text.ASV: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
text.WEB: for all the land which you see, I will give to you, and to your offspring forever.

text.KJV: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
text.ASV: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: So that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then may thy seed also be numbered.
text.WEB: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

text.KJV: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
text.ASV: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for unto thee will I give it.
text.WEB: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

text.KJV: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And Abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built there an altar unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,
text.WEB: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,

text.KJV: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
text.ASV: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).
text.WEB: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

text.KJV: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
text.ASV: All these joined together in the vale of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).
text.WEB: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

text.KJV: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
text.ASV: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
text.WEB: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year, they rebelled.

text.KJV: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emins in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
text.ASV: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
text.WEB: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

text.KJV: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
text.ASV: and the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
text.WEB: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

text.KJV: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
text.ASV: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat (the same is Kadesh), and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazazon-tamar.
text.WEB: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

text.KJV: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
text.ASV: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar); and they set the battle in array against them in the vale of Siddim;
text.WEB: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim;

text.KJV: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
text.ASV: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
text.WEB: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

text.KJV: And the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
text.ASV: Now the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and they that remained fled to the mountain.
text.WEB: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there, and those who remained fled to the hills.

text.KJV: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
text.ASV: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
text.WEB: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

text.KJV: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
text.ASV: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
text.WEB: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

text.KJV: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
text.ASV: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew: now he dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were confederate with Abram.
text.WEB: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and they were allies of Abram.

text.KJV: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
text.ASV: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.
text.WEB: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.

text.KJV: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
text.ASV: And he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
text.WEB: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

text.KJV: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
text.ASV: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
text.WEB: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

text.KJV: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
text.ASV: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of Shaveh (the same is the King's Vale).
text.WEB: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

text.KJV: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
text.ASV: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.
text.WEB: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.

text.KJV: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
text.ASV: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:
text.WEB: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:

text.KJV: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
text.ASV: and blessed be God Most High, who hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him a tenth of all.
text.WEB: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

text.KJV: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
text.ASV: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
text.WEB: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

text.KJV: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
text.ASV: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted up my hand unto Jehovah, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
text.WEB: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

text.KJV: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
text.ASV: that I will not take a thread nor a shoe-latchet nor aught that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
text.WEB: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

text.KJV: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
text.ASV: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men that went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.
text.WEB: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

text.KJV: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
text.ASV: After these things the word of Jehovah came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, `and' thy exceeding great reward.
text.WEB: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

text.KJV: And Abram said, LORD God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
text.ASV: And Abram said, O Lord Jehovah, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and he that shall be possessor of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?
text.WEB: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

text.KJV: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
text.ASV: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
text.WEB: Abram said, “Behold, to me you have given no children: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

text.KJV: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
text.ASV: And, behold, the word of Jehovah came unto him, saying, This man shall not be thine heir; But he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
text.WEB: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

text.KJV: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
text.ASV: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and number the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
text.WEB: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So will your offspring be.”

text.KJV: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
text.ASV: And he believed in Jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
text.WEB: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

text.KJV: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, I am Jehovah that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
text.WEB: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

text.KJV: And he said, LORD God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
text.ASV: And he said, O Lord Jehovah, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
text.WEB: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, Take me a heifer three years old, and a she-goat three years old, and a ram three years old, and a turtle-dove, and a young pigeon.
text.WEB: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

text.KJV: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
text.ASV: And he took him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each half over against the other: but the birds divided he not.
text.WEB: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

text.KJV: And when the fowls came down upon the carcasses, Abram drove them away.
text.ASV: And the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
text.WEB: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

text.KJV: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
text.ASV: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.
text.WEB: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

text.KJV: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
text.ASV: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be sojourners in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
text.WEB: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

text.KJV: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
text.ASV: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
text.WEB: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth,

text.KJV: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
text.ASV: But thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
text.WEB: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

text.KJV: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
text.ASV: And in the fourth generation they shall come hither again; for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.
text.WEB: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch that passed between these pieces.
text.WEB: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

text.KJV: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
text.ASV: In that day Jehovah made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
text.WEB: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

text.KJV: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
text.ASV: the Kenite, and the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,
text.WEB: the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

text.KJV: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaim,
text.ASV: and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,
text.WEB: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

text.KJV: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
text.ASV: and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
text.WEB: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

text.KJV: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
text.ASV: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, bare him no children: and she had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
text.WEB: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

text.KJV: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
text.ASV: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, Jehovah hath restrained me from bearing; go in, I pray thee, unto my handmaid; it may be that I shall obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
text.WEB: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

text.KJV: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
text.ASV: And Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
text.WEB: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

text.KJV: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
text.ASV: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
text.WEB: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

text.KJV: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
text.ASV: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I gave my handmaid into they bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: Jehovah judge between me and thee.
text.WEB: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes. Yahweh judge between me and you.”

text.KJV: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thine hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
text.ASV: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her that which is good in thine eyes. And Sarai dealt hardly with her, and she fled from her face.
text.WEB: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

text.KJV: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
text.ASV: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's handmaid, whence camest thou? and whither goest thou? And she said, I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.
text.WEB: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, I will greatly multiply thy seed, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son; and thou shalt call his name Ishmael, because Jehovah hath heard thy affliction.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.

text.KJV: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
text.ASV: And he shall be `as' a wild ass among men; his hand `shall be' against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell over against all his brethren.
text.WEB: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposite all of his brothers.”

text.KJV: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
text.ASV: And she called the name of Jehovah that spake unto her, Thou art a God that seeth: for she said, Have I even here looked after him that seeth me?
text.WEB: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

text.KJV: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
text.ASV: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
text.WEB: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

text.KJV: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
text.ASV: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bare, Ishmael.
text.WEB: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

text.KJV: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
text.ASV: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
text.WEB: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

text.KJV: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
text.ASV: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, Jehovah appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
text.WEB: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.

text.KJV: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
text.ASV: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
text.WEB: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

text.KJV: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
text.ASV: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
text.WEB: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

text.KJV: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
text.ASV: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be the father of a multitude of nations.
text.WEB: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

text.KJV: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
text.ASV: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for the father of a multitude of nations have I made thee.
text.WEB: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

text.KJV: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
text.ASV: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
text.WEB: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

text.KJV: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
text.ASV: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.
text.WEB: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

text.KJV: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
text.ASV: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land of thy sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
text.WEB: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

text.KJV: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
text.ASV: And God said unto Abraham, And as for thee, thou shalt keep my covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee throughout their generations.
text.WEB: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you will keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

text.KJV: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
text.ASV: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee: every male among you shall be circumcised.
text.WEB: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

text.KJV: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
text.ASV: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of a covenant betwixt me and you.
text.WEB: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

text.KJV: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
text.ASV: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any foreigner that is not of thy seed.
text.WEB: He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

text.KJV: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
text.ASV: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
text.WEB: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

text.KJV: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
text.ASV: And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
text.WEB: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

text.KJV: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
text.ASV: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
text.WEB: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.

text.KJV: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
text.ASV: And I will bless her, and moreover I will give thee a son of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be `a mother of' nations; kings of peoples shall be of her.
