text.WEB: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

text.KJV: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
text.ASV: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
text.WEB: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

text.KJV: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
text.ASV: And Abraham said unto God, Oh that Ishmael might live before thee!
text.WEB: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

text.KJV: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
text.ASV: And God said, Nay, but Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.
text.WEB: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

text.KJV: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
text.ASV: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
text.WEB: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

text.KJV: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
text.ASV: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
text.WEB: But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

text.KJV: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
text.ASV: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
text.WEB: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

text.KJV: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
text.ASV: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
text.WEB: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

text.KJV: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
text.ASV: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
text.WEB: Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

text.KJV: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
text.ASV: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
text.WEB: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

text.KJV: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
text.ASV: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
text.WEB: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

text.KJV: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
text.ASV: And all the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
text.WEB: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

text.KJV: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
text.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
text.WEB: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

text.KJV: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
text.ASV: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood over against him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
text.WEB: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood opposite him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

text.KJV: And said, My LORD, if now I have found favor in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
text.ASV: and said, My lord, if now I have found favor in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
text.WEB: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

text.KJV: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
text.ASV: let now a little water be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
text.WEB: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

text.KJV: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
text.ASV: and I will fetch a morsel of bread, and strengthen ye your heart; after that ye shall pass on: forasmuch as ye are come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
text.WEB: I will get a morsel of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

text.KJV: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
text.ASV: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.
text.WEB: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

text.KJV: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
text.ASV: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto the servant; and he hasted to dress it.
text.WEB: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

text.KJV: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
text.ASV: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
text.WEB: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

text.KJV: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
text.ASV: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
text.WEB: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “See, in the tent.”

text.KJV: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
text.ASV: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee when the season cometh round; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
text.WEB: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

text.KJV: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
text.ASV: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, `and' well stricken in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
text.WEB: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

text.KJV: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
text.ASV: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
text.WEB: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, who am old?
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child, yet I am old?’

text.KJV: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
text.ASV: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.
text.WEB: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”

text.KJV: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
text.ASV: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
text.WEB: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

text.KJV: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
text.ASV: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
text.WEB: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

text.KJV: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, Shall I hide from Abraham that which I do;
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

text.KJV: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
text.ASV: seeing that Abraham had surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
text.WEB: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

text.KJV: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
text.ASV: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Jehovah, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Jehovah may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
text.WEB: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

text.KJV: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

text.KJV: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
text.ASV: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
text.WEB: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

text.KJV: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
text.ASV: And the men turned from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before Jehovah.
text.WEB: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

text.KJV: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
text.ASV: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou consume the righteous with the wicked?
text.WEB: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

text.KJV: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
text.ASV: Peradventure there are fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
text.WEB: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

text.KJV: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
text.ASV: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, that so the righteous should be as the wicked; that be far from thee: shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
text.WEB: Be it far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

text.KJV: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sake.
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

text.KJV: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes:
text.ASV: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, who am but dust and ashes:
text.WEB: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

text.KJV: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
text.ASV: peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, I will not destroy it, if I find there forty and five.
text.WEB: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”

text.KJV: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
text.ASV: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for the forty's sake.
text.WEB: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
text.ASV: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
text.WEB: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

text.KJV: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
text.ASV: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the twenty's sake.
text.WEB: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

text.KJV: And he said, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
text.ASV: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the ten's sake.
text.WEB: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

text.KJV: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
text.ASV: And Jehovah went his way, as soon as he had left off communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
text.WEB: Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

text.KJV: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
text.ASV: And the two angels came to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth;
text.WEB: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

text.KJV: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
text.ASV: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn aside, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
text.WEB: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

text.KJV: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
text.ASV: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
text.WEB: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

text.KJV: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
text.ASV: But before they lay down, the men of the city, `even' the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both young and old, all the people from every quarter;
text.WEB: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

text.KJV: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
text.ASV: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men that came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
text.WEB: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

text.KJV: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
text.ASV: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.
text.WEB: Lot went out to them to the door, and shut the door after him.

text.KJV: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
text.ASV: And he said, I pray you, my brethren, do not so wickedly.
text.WEB: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

text.KJV: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
text.ASV: Behold now, I have two daughters that have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing, forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.
text.WEB: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

text.KJV: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
text.ASV: And they said, Stand back. And they said, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and drew near to break the door.
text.WEB: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

text.KJV: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
text.ASV: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
text.WEB: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

text.KJV: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
text.ASV: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
text.WEB: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

text.KJV: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
text.ASV: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of the place:
text.WEB: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whoever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

text.KJV: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.
text.ASV: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before Jehovah: and Jehovah hath sent us to destroy it.
text.WEB: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

text.KJV: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
text.ASV: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for Jehovah will destroy the city. But he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that mocked.
text.WEB: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

text.KJV: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
text.ASV: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here, lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
text.WEB: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife, and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

text.KJV: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
text.ASV: But he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters, Jehovah being merciful unto him; and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
text.WEB: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the Plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
text.WEB: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

text.KJV: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my LORD:
text.ASV: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my lord:
text.WEB: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

text.KJV: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
text.ASV: behold now, thy servant hath found favor in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy lovingkindness, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die:
text.WEB: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

text.KJV: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
text.ASV: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape thither (is it not a little one?), and my soul shall live.
text.WEB: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.
text.WEB: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

text.KJV: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
text.ASV: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
text.WEB: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

text.KJV: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
text.ASV: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.
text.WEB: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

text.KJV: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
text.ASV: Then Jehovah rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Jehovah out of heaven;
text.WEB: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

text.KJV: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
text.ASV: and he overthrew those cities, and all the Plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
text.WEB: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

text.KJV: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
text.ASV: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
text.WEB: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

text.KJV: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
text.ASV: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Jehovah:
text.WEB: Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

text.KJV: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
text.ASV: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the Plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
text.WEB: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.
text.WEB: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

text.KJV: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
text.ASV: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
text.WEB: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

text.KJV: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
text.ASV: And the first-born said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
text.WEB: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

text.KJV: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
text.ASV: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
text.WEB: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

text.KJV: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
text.ASV: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
text.WEB: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

text.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
text.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
text.WEB: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

text.KJV: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
text.ASV: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
text.WEB: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

text.KJV: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
text.ASV: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
text.WEB: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

text.KJV: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
text.ASV: And the first-born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
text.WEB: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

text.KJV: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
text.ASV: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
text.WEB: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

text.KJV: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
text.ASV: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur. And he sojourned in Gerar.
text.WEB: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

text.KJV: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
text.ASV: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister. And Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
text.WEB: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

text.KJV: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
text.ASV: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, because of the woman whom thou hast taken. For she is a man's wife.
text.WEB: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken. For she is a man’s wife.”

text.KJV: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, LORD, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
text.ASV: Now Abimelech had not come near her. And he said, Lord, wilt thou slay even a righteous nation?
text.WEB: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

text.KJV: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
text.ASV: Said he not himself unto me, She is my sister? And she, even she herself said, He is my brother. In the integrity of my heart and the innocency of my hands have I done this.
text.WEB: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister?’ She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this.”

text.KJV: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
text.ASV: And God said unto him in the dream, Yea, I know that in the integrity of thy heart thou has done this, and I also withheld thee from sinning against me. Therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
text.WEB: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

text.KJV: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
text.ASV: Now therefore restore the man's wife. For he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live. And if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
text.WEB: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

text.KJV: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
text.ASV: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. And the men were sore afraid.
text.WEB: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

text.KJV: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
text.ASV: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? And wherein have I sinned against thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? Thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
text.WEB: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

text.KJV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
text.ASV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
text.WEB: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

text.KJV: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
text.ASV: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place. And they will slay me for my wife's sake.
text.WEB: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

text.KJV: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
text.ASV: And moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:
text.WEB: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
text.ASV: and it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me. At every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
text.WEB: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

text.KJV: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
text.ASV: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
text.WEB: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

text.KJV: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
text.ASV: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee. Dwell where it pleaseth thee.
text.WEB: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

text.KJV: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
text.ASV: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for thee a covering of the eyes to all that are with thee. And in respect of all thou art righted.
text.WEB: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

text.KJV: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
text.ASV: And Abraham prayed unto God. And God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maid-servants. And they bare children.
text.WEB: Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

text.KJV: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
text.ASV: For Jehovah had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
text.WEB: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

text.KJV: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
text.ASV: And Jehovah visited Sarah as he had said, and Jehovah did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
text.WEB: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

text.KJV: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
text.ASV: And Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
text.WEB: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

text.KJV: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
text.ASV: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
text.WEB: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

text.KJV: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
text.ASV: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
text.WEB: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

text.KJV: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
text.ASV: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
text.WEB: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

text.KJV: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
text.ASV: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh. Every one that heareth will laugh with me.
text.WEB: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

text.KJV: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
text.ASV: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? For I have borne him a son in his old age.
text.WEB: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

text.KJV: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
text.ASV: And the child grew, and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
text.WEB: The child grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

text.KJV: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
text.ASV: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne unto Abraham, mocking.
text.WEB: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

text.KJV: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
text.ASV: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this handmaid and her son. For the son of this handmaid shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
text.WEB: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

text.KJV: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
text.ASV: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight on account of his son.
text.WEB: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

text.KJV: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
text.ASV: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy handmaid. In all that Sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice. For in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
text.WEB: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

text.KJV: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
text.ASV: And also of the son of the handmaid will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
text.WEB: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

text.KJV: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
text.ASV: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and `gave her' the child, and sent her away. And she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
text.WEB: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

text.KJV: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
text.ASV: And the water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
text.WEB: The water in the bottle was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

text.KJV: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
text.ASV: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot. For she said, Let me not look upon the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
text.WEB: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

text.KJV: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
text.ASV: And God heard the voice of the lad. And the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? Fear not. For God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
text.WEB: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What ails you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

text.KJV: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
text.ASV: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thy hand. For I will make him a great nation.
text.WEB: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

text.KJV: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
text.ASV: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. And she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
text.WEB: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the bottle with water, and gave the boy drink.

text.KJV: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
text.ASV: And God was with the lad, and he grew. And he dwelt in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.
text.WEB: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.

text.KJV: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran. And his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
text.ASV: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest.
text.WEB: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

text.KJV: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
text.ASV: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son. But according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
text.WEB: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

text.KJV: And Abraham said, I will swear.
text.ASV: And Abraham said, I will swear.
text.WEB: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

text.KJV: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
text.ASV: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of the well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
text.WEB: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

text.KJV: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
text.ASV: And Abimelech said, I know not who hath done this thing. Neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to-day.
text.WEB: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

text.KJV: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
text.ASV: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech. And they two made a covenant.
text.WEB: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

text.KJV: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
text.ASV: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
text.WEB: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

text.KJV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
text.ASV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
text.WEB: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”

text.KJV: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
text.ASV: And he said, These seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
text.WEB: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

text.KJV: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
text.ASV: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba. Because there they sware both of them.
text.WEB: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

text.KJV: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
text.ASV: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba. And Abimelech rose up, and Phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
text.WEB: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

text.KJV: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
text.ASV: And `Abraham' planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Jehovah, the Everlasting God.
text.WEB: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

text.KJV: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
text.ASV: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.
text.WEB: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
text.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that God did prove Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham. And he said, Here am I.
text.WEB: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

text.KJV: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
text.ASV: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son, whom thou lovest, even Isaac, and get thee into the land of Moriah. And offer him there for a burnt-offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
text.WEB: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

text.KJV: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
text.ASV: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. And he clave the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
text.WEB: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

text.KJV: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
text.ASV: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
text.WEB: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

text.KJV: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
text.ASV: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will go yonder; and we will worship, and come again to you.
text.WEB: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”

text.KJV: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
text.ASV: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son. And he took in his hand the fire and the knife. And they went both of them together.
text.WEB: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

text.KJV: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
text.ASV: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father. And he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold, the fire and the wood. But where is the lamb for a burnt-offering?
text.WEB: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

text.KJV: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
text.ASV: And Abraham said, God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son. So they went both of them together.
text.WEB: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

text.KJV: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
text.ASV: And they came to the place which God had told him of. And Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.
text.WEB: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

text.KJV: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
text.ASV: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
text.WEB: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham. And he said, Here I am.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

text.KJV: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
text.ASV: And he said, Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou anything unto him. For now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from me.
text.WEB: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

text.KJV: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
text.ASV: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold, behind `him' a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. And Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
text.WEB: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

text.KJV: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
text.ASV: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh. As it is said to this day, In the mount of Jehovah it shall be provided.
text.WEB: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah called unto Abraham a second time out of heaven,
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

text.KJV: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
text.ASV: and said, By myself have I sworn, saith Jehovah, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,
text.WEB: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

text.KJV: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
text.ASV: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heavens, and as the sand which is upon the seashore. And thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies.
text.WEB: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

text.KJV: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
text.ASV: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed. Because thou hast obeyed my voice.
text.WEB: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.”

text.KJV: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
text.ASV: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba. And Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
text.WEB: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
text.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she also hath borne children unto they brother Nahor.
text.WEB: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

text.KJV: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
text.ASV: Uz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram.
text.WEB: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

text.KJV: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
text.ASV: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
text.WEB: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

text.KJV: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
text.ASV: And Bethuel begat Rebekah. These eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
text.WEB: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

text.KJV: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
text.ASV: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she also bare Tebah, and Gaham, and Tahash, and Maacah.
text.WEB: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

text.KJV: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
text.ASV: And the life of Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years. These were the years of the life of Sarah.
text.WEB: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

text.KJV: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
text.ASV: And Sarah died in Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
text.WEB: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

text.KJV: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
text.ASV: And Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spake unto the children of Heth, saying,
text.WEB: Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

text.KJV: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
text.ASV: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
text.WEB: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

text.KJV: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
text.ASV: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
text.WEB: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

text.KJV: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
text.ASV: Hear us, my lord. Thou art a prince of God among us. In the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead. None of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
text.WEB: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

text.KJV: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
text.ASV: And Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
text.WEB: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

text.KJV: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
text.ASV: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
text.WEB: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

text.KJV: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
text.ASV: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him give it to me in the midst of you for a possession of a burying-place.
text.WEB: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him give it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

text.KJV: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
text.ASV: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of Heth. And Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
text.WEB: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

text.KJV: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
text.ASV: Nay, my lord, hear me. The field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee. In the presence of the children of my people give I it thee. Bury thy dead.
text.WEB: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

text.KJV: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
text.ASV: And Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
text.WEB: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

text.KJV: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
text.ASV: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
text.WEB: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

text.KJV: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
text.ASV: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
text.WEB: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

text.KJV: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
text.ASV: My lord, hearken unto me. A piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that betwixt me and thee? Bury therefore thy dead.
text.WEB: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

text.KJV: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
text.ASV: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron. And Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current `money' with the merchant.
text.WEB: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

text.KJV: And the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
text.ASV: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure
text.WEB: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

text.KJV: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
text.ASV: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
text.WEB: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

text.KJV: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
text.ASV: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
text.WEB: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
text.ASV: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of Heth.
text.WEB: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

text.KJV: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
text.ASV: And Abraham was old, `and' well stricken in age. And Jehovah had blessed Abraham in all things.
text.WEB: Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

text.KJV: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
text.ASV: And Abraham said unto his servant, the elder of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh.
text.WEB: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

text.KJV: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
text.ASV: And I will make thee swear by Jehovah, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that thou wilt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell.
text.WEB: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

text.KJV: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
text.ASV: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son Isaac.
text.WEB: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

text.KJV: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
text.ASV: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land. Must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
text.WEB: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

text.KJV: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
text.ASV: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
text.WEB: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

text.KJV: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
text.ASV: Jehovah, the God of heaven, who took me from my father's house, and from the land of my nativity, and who spake unto me, and who sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land. He will send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from thence.
text.WEB: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring. He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

text.KJV: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
text.ASV: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath. Only thou shalt not bring my son thither again.
text.WEB: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

text.KJV: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
