text.ASV: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning this matter.
text.WEB: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

text.KJV: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
text.ASV: And the servant took ten camels, of the camels of his master, and departed, having all goodly things of his master's in his hand. And he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
text.WEB: The servant took ten camels, of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

text.KJV: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
text.ASV: And he made the camels to kneel down without the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
text.WEB: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

text.KJV: And he said O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.
text.ASV: And he said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.
text.WEB: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

text.KJV: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
text.ASV: Behold, I am standing by the fountain of water. And the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
text.WEB: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

text.KJV: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast showed kindness unto my master.
text.ASV: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink. And she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also. Let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac. And thereby shall I know that thou hast showed kindness unto my master.
text.WEB: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
text.WEB: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

text.KJV: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
text.ASV: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her. And she went down to the fountain, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
text.WEB: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

text.KJV: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
text.ASV: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Give me to drink, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher.
text.WEB: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

text.KJV: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
text.ASV: And she said, Drink, my lord. And she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
text.WEB: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

text.KJV: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
text.ASV: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
text.WEB: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

text.KJV: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
text.ASV: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
text.WEB: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

text.KJV: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
text.ASV: And the man looked stedfastly on her, holding his peace, to know whether Jehovah had made his journey prosperous or not.
text.WEB: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
text.WEB: As the camels had done drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

text.KJV: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
text.ASV: and said, Whose daughter art thou? Tell me, I pray thee. Is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
text.WEB: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

text.KJV: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
text.ASV: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bare unto Nahor.
text.WEB: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

text.KJV: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
text.ASV: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
text.WEB: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

text.KJV: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
text.ASV: And the man bowed his head, and worshipped Jehovah.
text.WEB: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

text.KJV: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.
text.ASV: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, who hath not forsaken his lovingkindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Jehovah hath led me in the way to the house of my master's brethren.
text.WEB: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

text.KJV: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
text.ASV: And the damsel ran, and told her mother's house according to these words.
text.WEB: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

text.KJV: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
text.ASV: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain.
text.WEB: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me. That he came unto the man. And, behold, he was standing by the camels at the fountain.
text.WEB: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

text.KJV: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
text.ASV: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of Jehovah. Wherefore standest thou without? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
text.WEB: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

text.KJV: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
text.ASV: And the man came into the house, and he ungirded the camels. And he gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.
text.WEB: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

text.KJV: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
text.ASV: And there was set food before him to eat. But he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
text.WEB: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” He said, “Speak on.”

text.KJV: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
text.ASV: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
text.WEB: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

text.KJV: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
text.ASV: And Jehovah hath blessed my master greatly. And he is become great. And he hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.
text.WEB: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

text.KJV: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
text.ASV: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old. And unto him hath he given all that he hath.
text.WEB: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

text.KJV: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
text.ASV: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell.
text.WEB: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

text.KJV: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
text.ASV: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.
text.WEB: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

text.KJV: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
text.ASV: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
text.WEB: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

text.KJV: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
text.ASV: And he said unto me, Jehovah, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way. And thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house.
text.WEB: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

text.KJV: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
text.ASV: Then shalt thou be clear from my oath, when thou comest to my kindred. And if they give her not to thee, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
text.WEB: Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

text.KJV: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
text.ASV: And I came this day unto the fountain, and said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go.
text.WEB: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

text.KJV: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
text.ASV: Behold, I am standing by the fountain of water. And let it come to pass, that the maiden that cometh forth to draw, to whom I shall say, Give me, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink.
text.WEB: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

text.KJV: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.
text.ASV: And she shall say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels. Let the same be the woman whom Jehovah hath appointed for my master's son.
text.WEB: and she will tell me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

text.KJV: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
text.ASV: And before I had done speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder. And she went down unto the fountain, and drew. And I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
text.WEB: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

text.KJV: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
text.ASV: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also. So I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
text.WEB: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

text.KJV: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, the daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
text.ASV: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him. And I put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.
text.WEB: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

text.KJV: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
text.ASV: And I bowed my head, and worshipped Jehovah, and blessed Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.
text.WEB: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

text.KJV: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
text.ASV: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. And if not, tell me. That I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
text.WEB: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

text.KJV: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
text.ASV: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from Jehovah. We cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
text.WEB: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

text.KJV: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.
text.ASV: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as Jehovah hath spoken.
text.WEB: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
text.ASV: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah. He gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
text.WEB: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

text.KJV: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
text.ASV: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night. And they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
text.WEB: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

text.KJV: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
text.ASV: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us `a few' days, at the least ten. After that she shall go.
text.WEB: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing Jehovah hath prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

text.KJV: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.
text.ASV: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.
text.WEB: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

text.KJV: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
text.ASV: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
text.WEB: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

text.KJV: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
text.ASV: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
text.WEB: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

text.KJV: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
text.ASV: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Our sister, be thou `the mother' of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those that hate them.
text.WEB: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

text.KJV: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
text.ASV: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man. And the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
text.WEB: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

text.KJV: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
text.ASV: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi. For he dwelt in the land of the South.
text.WEB: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

text.KJV: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
text.ASV: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide. And he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.
text.WEB: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

text.KJV: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
text.ASV: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she alighted from the camel.
text.WEB: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

text.KJV: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
text.ASV: And she said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant said, It is my master. And she took her veil, and covered herself.
text.WEB: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

text.KJV: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
text.ASV: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
text.WEB: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

text.KJV: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
text.ASV: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. And he loved her. And Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
text.WEB: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

text.KJV: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
text.ASV: And Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
text.WEB: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

text.KJV: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
text.ASV: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
text.WEB: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

text.KJV: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
text.ASV: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
text.WEB: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

text.KJV: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
text.ASV: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
text.WEB: The sons of Midian were: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

text.KJV: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
text.ASV: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
text.WEB: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

text.KJV: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
text.ASV: But unto the sons of the concubines, that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts. And he sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
text.WEB: but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham gave gifts. He sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.

text.KJV: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
text.ASV: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.
text.WEB: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

text.KJV: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
text.ASV: And Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full `of years', and was gathered to his people.
text.WEB: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

text.KJV: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
text.ASV: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre.
text.WEB: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,

text.KJV: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
text.ASV: The field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. There was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
text.WEB: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
text.ASV: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son. And Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.
text.WEB: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

text.KJV: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
text.ASV: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham.
text.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

text.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
text.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth, and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
text.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

text.KJV: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
text.ASV: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
text.WEB: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

text.KJV: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
text.ASV: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
text.WEB: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
text.ASV: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments. Twelve princes according to their nations.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

text.KJV: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
text.ASV: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years. And he gave up the ghost and died, and was gathered unto his people.
text.WEB: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

text.KJV: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
text.ASV: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria. He abode over against all his brethren.
text.WEB: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

text.KJV: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:
text.ASV: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham begat Isaac.
text.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

text.KJV: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
text.ASV: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
text.WEB: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

text.KJV: And Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
text.ASV: And Isaac entreated Jehovah for his wife, because she was barren. And Jehovah was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
text.WEB: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

text.KJV: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to inquire of the LORD.
text.ASV: And the children struggled together within her. And she said, If it be so, wherefore do I live? And she went to inquire of Jehovah.
text.WEB: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is so, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, And two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels. And the one people shall be stronger than the other people. And the elder shall serve the younger.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

text.KJV: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
text.ASV: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
text.WEB: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

text.KJV: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
text.ASV: And the first came forth red, all over like a hairy garment. And they called his name Esau.
text.WEB: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

text.KJV: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
text.ASV: And after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on Esau's heel. And his name was called Jacob. And Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
text.WEB: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

text.KJV: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
text.ASV: And the boys grew. And Esau was a skilful hunter, a man of the field. And Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
text.WEB: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

text.KJV: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
text.ASV: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison. And Rebekah loved Jacob.
text.WEB: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

text.KJV: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
text.ASV: And Jacob boiled pottage. And Esau came in from the field, and he was faint.
text.WEB: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

text.KJV: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
text.ASV: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red `pottage'. For I am faint. Therefore was his name called Edom.
text.WEB: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

text.KJV: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
text.ASV: And Jacob said, Sell me first thy birthright.
text.WEB: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

text.KJV: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
text.ASV: And Esau said, Behold, I am about to die. And what profit shall the birthright do to me?
text.WEB: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

text.KJV: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
text.ASV: And Jacob said, Swear to me first. And he sware unto him. And he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
text.WEB: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

text.KJV: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
text.ASV: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils. And he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
text.WEB: Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

text.KJV: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
text.ASV: And there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines, unto Gerar.
text.WEB: There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

text.KJV: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
text.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt. Dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of.
text.WEB: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

text.KJV: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
text.ASV: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee. For unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father.
text.WEB: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

text.KJV: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
text.ASV: And I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these lands. And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed.
text.WEB: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring will all the nations of the earth be blessed,

text.KJV: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
text.ASV: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
text.WEB: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

text.KJV: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
text.ASV: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar.
text.WEB: Isaac lived in Gerar.

text.KJV: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
text.ASV: And the men of the place asked him of his wife. And he said, She is my sister. For he feared to say, My wife. Lest, `said he', the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah. Because she was fair to look upon.
text.WEB: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
text.WEB: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

text.KJV: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
text.ASV: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife. And how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die because of her.
text.WEB: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister?’” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

text.KJV: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
text.ASV: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? One of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
text.WEB: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

text.KJV: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

text.KJV: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
text.ASV: And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold. And Jehovah blessed him.
text.WEB: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

text.KJV: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
text.ASV: And the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
text.WEB: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

text.KJV: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
text.ASV: And he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household. And the Philistines envied him.
text.WEB: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

text.KJV: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
text.ASV: Now all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
text.WEB: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

text.KJV: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
text.ASV: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us. For thou art much mightier than we.
text.WEB: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

text.KJV: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
text.ASV: And Isaac departed thence, and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
text.WEB: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

text.KJV: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
text.ASV: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father. For the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. And he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
text.WEB: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father. For the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

text.KJV: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
text.ASV: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
text.WEB: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

text.KJV: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
text.ASV: And the herdsmen of Gerar strove with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, The water is ours. And he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
text.WEB: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” He called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

text.KJV: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
text.ASV: And they digged another well, and they strove for that also. And he called the name of it Sitnah.
text.WEB: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. He called its name Sitnah.

text.KJV: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
text.ASV: And he removed from thence, and digged another well. And for that they strove not. And he called the name of it Rehoboth. And he said, For now Jehovah hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
text.WEB: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. He called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

text.KJV: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
text.ASV: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.
text.WEB: He went up from there to Beersheba.

text.KJV: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
text.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father. Fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
text.WEB: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

text.KJV: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
text.ASV: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Jehovah, and pitched his tent there. And there Isaac's servants digged a well.
text.WEB: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

text.KJV: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
text.ASV: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his host.
text.WEB: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

text.KJV: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
text.ASV: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
text.WEB: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

text.KJV: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
text.ASV: And they said, We saw plainly that Jehovah was with thee. And we said, Let there now be an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee,
text.WEB: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you,

text.KJV: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.
text.ASV: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace. Thou art now the blessed of Jehovah.
text.WEB: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”

text.KJV: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
text.ASV: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
text.WEB: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

text.KJV: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
text.ASV: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another. And Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
text.WEB: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

text.KJV: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
text.ASV: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
text.WEB: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

text.KJV: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
text.ASV: And he called it Shibah. Therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.
text.WEB: He called it Shibah. Therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.

text.KJV: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
text.ASV: And when Esau was forty years old he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
text.WEB: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

text.KJV: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
text.ASV: And they were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
text.WEB: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said unto him, My son. And he said unto him, Here am I.
text.WEB: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

text.KJV: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
text.ASV: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death.
text.WEB: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

text.KJV: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
text.ASV: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison.
text.WEB: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison.

text.KJV: And make me savory meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
text.ASV: And make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat. That my soul may bless thee before I die.
text.WEB: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

text.KJV: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
text.ASV: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
text.WEB: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

text.KJV: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
text.ASV: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
text.WEB: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

text.KJV: Bring me venison, and make me savory meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
text.ASV: Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless thee before Jehovah before my death.
text.WEB: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’

text.KJV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
text.ASV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
text.WEB: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

text.KJV: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savory meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
text.ASV: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats. And I will make them savory food for thy father, such as he loveth.
text.WEB: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

text.KJV: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
text.ASV: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, so that he may bless thee before his death.
text.WEB: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

text.KJV: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
text.ASV: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
text.WEB: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

text.KJV: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
text.ASV: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver. And I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
text.WEB: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

text.KJV: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
text.ASV: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son. Only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
text.WEB: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

text.KJV: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savory meat, such as his father loved.
text.ASV: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother. And his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
text.WEB: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

text.KJV: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
text.ASV: And Rebekah took the goodly garments of Esau her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son.
text.WEB: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

text.KJV: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
text.ASV: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck.
text.WEB: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

text.KJV: And she gave the savory meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
text.ASV: And she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
text.WEB: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

text.KJV: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
text.ASV: And he came unto his father, and said, My father. And he said, Here am I. Who art thou, my son?
text.WEB: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

text.KJV: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
text.ASV: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first-born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
text.WEB: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

text.KJV: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.
text.ASV: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because Jehovah thy God sent me good speed.
text.WEB: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”

text.KJV: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
text.ASV: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
text.WEB: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

text.KJV: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
text.ASV: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father. And he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
text.WEB: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

text.KJV: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
text.ASV: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands. So he blessed him.
text.WEB: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother, Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

text.KJV: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
text.ASV: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
text.WEB: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

text.KJV: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine and he drank.
text.ASV: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat. And he brought him wine, and he drank.
text.WEB: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

text.KJV: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
text.ASV: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
text.WEB: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

text.KJV: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
text.ASV: And he came near, and kissed him. And he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son Is as the smell of a field which Jehovah hath blessed.
text.WEB: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahweh has blessed.

text.KJV: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
text.ASV: And God give thee of the dew of heaven, And of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and new wine.
text.WEB: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

text.KJV: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
text.ASV: Let peoples serve thee, And nations bow down to thee. Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother's sons bow down to thee. Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be every one that blesseth thee.
text.WEB: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
text.WEB: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

text.KJV: And he also had made savory meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
text.ASV: And he also made savory food, and brought it unto his father. And he said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
text.WEB: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

text.KJV: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
text.ASV: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy first-born, Esau.
text.WEB: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

text.KJV: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
text.ASV: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who then is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? Yea, `and' he shall be blessed.
text.WEB: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

text.KJV: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
text.ASV: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
text.WEB: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

text.KJV: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
text.ASV: And he said, Thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.
text.WEB: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

text.KJV: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
text.ASV: And he said, Is not he rightly name Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two time. He took away my birthright. And, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
text.WEB: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

text.KJV: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
text.ASV: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants. And with grain and new wine have I sustained him. And what then shall I do for thee, my son?
text.WEB: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

text.KJV: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
text.ASV: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
text.WEB: Esau said to his father, “Have you but one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

text.KJV: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
text.ASV: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, of the fatness of the earth shall be thy dwelling, And of the dew of heaven from above.
text.WEB: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, of the fatness of the earth will be your dwelling, and of the dew of the sky from above.

text.KJV: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
text.ASV: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and thou shalt serve thy brother. And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt break loose, That thou shalt shake his yoke from off thy neck.
text.WEB: By your sword will you live, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you shall shake his yoke from off your neck.”

text.KJV: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
text.ASV: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him. And Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then will I slay my brother Jacob.
text.WEB: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

text.KJV: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
text.ASV: And the words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah. And she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, `purposing' to kill thee.
text.WEB: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

text.KJV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
text.ASV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. And arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran.
text.WEB: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

text.KJV: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
text.ASV: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away.
text.WEB: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away;

text.KJV: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
text.ASV: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him. Then I will send, and fetch thee from thence. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?
text.WEB: until your brother’s anger turn away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

text.KJV: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
text.ASV: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
text.WEB: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

text.KJV: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
text.ASV: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
text.WEB: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

text.KJV: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.
text.ASV: Arise, go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father. And take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.
text.WEB: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

text.KJV: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
text.ASV: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a company of peoples.
text.WEB: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

text.KJV: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
text.ASV: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee. That thou mayest inherit the land of thy sojournings, which God gave unto Abraham.
text.WEB: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you, and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

text.KJV: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
text.ASV: And Isaac sent away Jacob. And he went to Paddan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
text.WEB: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, Rebekah’s brother, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

text.KJV: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
text.ASV: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram, to take him a wife from thence. And that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
text.WEB: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan,”

text.KJV: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
text.ASV: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan-aram.
text.WEB: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

text.KJV: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
text.ASV: And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father.
text.WEB: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

text.KJV: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
text.ASV: And Esau went unto Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
text.WEB: Esau went to Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

text.KJV: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
text.ASV: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.
text.WEB: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

text.KJV: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
text.ASV: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set. And he took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
text.WEB: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

text.KJV: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
text.ASV: And he dreamed. And behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven. And behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
text.WEB: He dreamed. Behold, a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

text.KJV: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
text.ASV: And, behold, Jehovah stood above it, and said, I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac. The land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.
text.WEB: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. The land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your offspring.

text.KJV: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
text.ASV: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. And in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
text.WEB: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed.

text.KJV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
text.ASV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee, whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land. For I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
text.WEB: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

text.KJV: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
text.ASV: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely Jehovah is in this place. And I knew it not.
text.WEB: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

text.KJV: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
text.ASV: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
text.WEB: He was afraid, and said, “How dreadful is this place! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

text.KJV: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
text.ASV: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
