text.WEB: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

text.KJV: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
text.ASV: And he called the name of that place Beth-el. But the name of the city was Luz at the first.
text.WEB: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

text.KJV: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
text.ASV: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
text.WEB: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

text.KJV: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
text.ASV: so that I come again to my father's house in peace, and Jehovah will be my God,
text.WEB: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

text.KJV: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
text.ASV: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God's house. And of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
text.WEB: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

text.KJV: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
text.ASV: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
text.WEB: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

text.KJV: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
text.ASV: And he looked, and behold, a well in the field, and, lo, three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. And the stone upon the well's mouth was great.
text.WEB: He looked, and behold, a well in the field, and, behold, three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

text.KJV: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
text.ASV: And thither were all the flocks gathered. And they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in its place.
text.WEB: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again on the well’s mouth in its place.

text.KJV: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
text.ASV: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence are ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
text.WEB: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Is it well with him? And they said, It is well. And, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

text.KJV: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
text.ASV: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together. Water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
text.WEB: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

text.KJV: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
text.ASV: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth. Then we water the sheep.
text.WEB: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we water the sheep.”

text.KJV: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.
text.ASV: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep. For she kept them.
text.WEB: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
text.WEB: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

text.KJV: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
text.ASV: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
text.WEB: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

text.KJV: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
text.ASV: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son. And she ran and told her father.
text.WEB: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
text.WEB: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

text.KJV: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
text.ASV: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
text.WEB: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” He stayed with him for a month.

text.KJV: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
text.ASV: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? Tell me, what shall thy wages be?
text.WEB: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my brother, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

text.KJV: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
text.ASV: And Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
text.WEB: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

text.KJV: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favored.
text.ASV: And Leah's eyes were tender. But Rachel was beautiful and well favored.
text.WEB: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

text.KJV: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
text.ASV: And Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
text.WEB: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

text.KJV: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
text.ASV: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man. Abide with me.
text.WEB: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

text.KJV: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
text.ASV: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel. And they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
text.WEB: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

text.KJV: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
text.ASV: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
text.WEB: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

text.KJV: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
text.ASV: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
text.WEB: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

text.KJV: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him. And he went in unto her.
text.WEB: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him. He went in to her.

text.KJV: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
text.ASV: And Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter Leah for a handmaid.
text.WEB: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was Leah. And he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? Did not I serve with thee for Rachel? Wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
text.WEB: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

text.KJV: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
text.ASV: And Laban said, It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born.
text.WEB: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

text.KJV: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
text.ASV: Fulfil the week of this one, and we will give thee the other also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
text.WEB: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me yet seven other years.”

text.KJV: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
text.ASV: And jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. And he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife.
text.WEB: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

text.KJV: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
text.ASV: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.
text.WEB: Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah, his servant, to be her servant.

text.KJV: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
text.ASV: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
text.WEB: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

text.KJV: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
text.ASV: And Jehovah saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb. But Rachel was barren.
text.WEB: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

text.KJV: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
text.ASV: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben. For she said, Because Jehovah hath looked upon my affliction. For now my husband will love me.
text.WEB: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

text.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
text.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and said, Because Jehovah hath heard that I am hated, he hath therefore given me this `son' also. And she called his name Simeon.
text.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

text.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
text.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son. And said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have borne him three sons. Therefore was his name called Levi.
text.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son. Said, “Now this time will my husband be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

text.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
text.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son. And she said, This time will I praise Jehovah. Therefore she called his name Judah. And she left off bearing.
text.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time will I praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

text.KJV: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
text.ASV: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and she said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
text.WEB: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

text.KJV: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
text.ASV: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
text.WEB: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

text.KJV: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
text.ASV: And she said, Behold, my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; that she may bear upon my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.
text.WEB: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

text.KJV: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
text.ASV: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
text.WEB: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

text.KJV: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
text.ASV: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
text.WEB: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

text.KJV: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
text.ASV: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
text.WEB: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore called she his name Dan.

text.KJV: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
text.ASV: And Bilhah Rachel's handmaid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
text.WEB: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

text.KJV: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
text.ASV: And Rachel said, With mighty wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
text.WEB: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

text.KJV: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
text.ASV: When Leah saw that she had left off bearing, she took Zilpah her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob to wife.
text.WEB: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

text.KJV: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
text.ASV: And Zilpah Leah's handmaid bare Jacob a son.
text.WEB: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

text.KJV: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
text.ASV: And Leah said, Fortunate! and she called his name Gad.
text.WEB: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

text.KJV: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
text.ASV: And Zilpah Leah's handmaid bare Jacob a second son.
text.WEB: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

text.KJV: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
text.ASV: And Leah said, Happy am I! for the daughters will call me happy: and she called his name Asher.
text.WEB: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

text.KJV: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
text.ASV: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
text.WEB: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

text.KJV: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
text.ASV: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken away my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to-night for thy son's mandrakes.
text.WEB: She said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

text.KJV: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
text.ASV: And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for I have surely hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
text.WEB: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

text.KJV: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
text.ASV: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a fifth son.
text.WEB: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

text.KJV: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
text.ASV: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
text.WEB: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

text.KJV: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
text.ASV: And Leah conceived again, and bare a sixth son to Jacob.
text.WEB: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

text.KJV: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
text.ASV: And Leah said, God hath endowed me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
text.WEB: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

text.KJV: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
text.ASV: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
text.WEB: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

text.KJV: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
text.ASV: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
text.WEB: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

text.KJV: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
text.ASV: And she conceived, and bare a son: and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
text.WEB: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

text.KJV: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
text.ASV: and she called his name Joseph, saying, Jehovah add to me another son.
text.WEB: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
text.WEB: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

text.KJV: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
text.ASV: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service wherewith I have served thee.
text.WEB: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

text.KJV: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favor in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
text.ASV: And Laban said unto him, If now I have found favor in thine eyes, `tarry': `for' I have divined that Jehovah hath blessed me for thy sake.
text.WEB: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”

text.KJV: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
text.ASV: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
text.WEB: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle have fared with me.
text.WEB: He said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

text.KJV: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
text.ASV: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it hath increased unto a multitude; and Jehovah hath blessed thee whithersoever I turned: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
text.WEB: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

text.KJV: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
text.ASV: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me aught: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed thy flock and keep it.
text.WEB: He said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

text.KJV: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
text.ASV: I will pass through all thy flock to-day, removing from thence every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and `of such' shall be my hire.
text.WEB: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

text.KJV: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
text.ASV: So shall my righteousness answer for me hereafter, when thou shalt come concerning my hire that is before thee: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that `if found' with me, shall be counted stolen.
text.WEB: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

text.KJV: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
text.ASV: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
text.WEB: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

text.KJV: And he removed that day the he goats that were ring-streaked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
text.ASV: And he removed that day the he-goats that were ringstreaked and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons;
text.WEB: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

text.KJV: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
text.ASV: and he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
text.WEB: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

text.KJV: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
text.ASV: And Jacob took him rods of fresh poplar, and of the almond and of the plane-tree. And peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
text.WEB: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

text.KJV: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
text.ASV: And he set the rods which he had peeled over against the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink; and they conceived when they came to drink.
text.WEB: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

text.KJV: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ring-streaked, speckled, and spotted.
text.ASV: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth ringstreaked, speckled, and spotted.
text.WEB: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

text.KJV: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ring-streaked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
text.ASV: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstreaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and put them not unto Laban's flock.
text.WEB: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger of the flock did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;
text.WEB: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;

text.KJV: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
text.ASV: but when the flock were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
text.WEB: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

text.KJV: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
text.ASV: And the man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, and maid-servants and men-servants, and camels and asses.
text.WEB: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

text.KJV: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
text.ASV: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
text.WEB: He heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

text.KJV: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
text.ASV: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as beforetime.
text.WEB: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

text.KJV: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
text.ASV: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
text.WEB: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

text.KJV: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
text.ASV: and said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as beforetime; but the God of my father hath been with me.
text.WEB: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

text.KJV: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
text.ASV: And ye know that will all my power I have served your father.
text.WEB: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

text.KJV: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
text.ASV: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
text.WEB: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

text.KJV: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ring-streaked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ring-streaked.
text.ASV: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the flock bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstreaked shall be thy wages; then bare all the flock ringstreaked.
text.WEB: If he said this, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said this, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

text.KJV: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
text.ASV: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
text.WEB: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

text.KJV: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ring-streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
text.ASV: And it came to pass at the time that the flock conceive, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the he-goats which leaped upon the flock were ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled.
text.WEB: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

text.KJV: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
text.ASV: And the angel of God said unto me in the dream, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.
text.WEB: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

text.KJV: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ring-streaked, speckled, and grizzled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
text.ASV: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the he-goats which leap upon the flock are ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
text.WEB: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

text.KJV: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
text.ASV: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst a pillar, where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy nativity.
text.WEB: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

text.KJV: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
text.ASV: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
text.WEB: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

text.KJV: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
text.ASV: Are we not accounted by him as foreigners? for he hath sold us, and hath also quite devoured our money.
text.WEB: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

text.KJV: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
text.ASV: For all the riches which God hath taken away from our father, that is ours and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
text.WEB: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father, that is ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

text.KJV: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
text.ASV: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon the camels;
text.WEB: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

text.KJV: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
text.ASV: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his substance which he had gathered, the cattle of his getting, which he had gathered in Paddan-aram, to go to Isaac his father unto the land of Canaan.
text.WEB: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
text.ASV: Now Laban was gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.
text.WEB: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

text.KJV: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
text.ASV: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
text.WEB: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

text.KJV: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
text.ASV: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
text.WEB: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

text.KJV: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
text.ASV: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
text.WEB: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

text.KJV: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
text.ASV: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and he overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
text.WEB: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

text.KJV: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
text.ASV: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said unto him, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
text.WEB: God came to Laban, the Syrian, in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

text.KJV: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
text.ASV: And Laban came up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain: and Laban with his brethren encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
text.WEB: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

text.KJV: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
text.ASV: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters as captives of the sword?
text.WEB: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

text.KJV: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
text.ASV: Wherefore didst thou flee secretly, and steal away from me, and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth and with songs, with tabret and with harp;
text.WEB: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

text.KJV: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
text.ASV: and didst not suffer me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now hast thou done foolishly.
text.WEB: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now have you done foolishly.

text.KJV: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
text.ASV: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
text.WEB: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

text.KJV: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
text.ASV: And now, `though' thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, `yet' wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
text.WEB: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

text.KJV: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
text.ASV: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Lest thou shouldest take thy daughters from me by force.
text.WEB: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

text.KJV: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
text.ASV: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
text.WEB: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

text.KJV: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
text.ASV: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the tent of the two maid-servants; but he found them not. And he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
text.WEB: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

text.KJV: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
text.ASV: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the camel's saddle, and sat upon them. And Laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.
text.WEB: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

text.KJV: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched but found not the images.
text.ASV: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the teraphim.
text.WEB: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

text.KJV: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
text.ASV: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast hotly pursued after me?
text.WEB: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

text.KJV: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
text.ASV: Whereas thou hast felt about all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? Set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us two.
text.WEB: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

text.KJV: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
text.ASV: These twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flocks have I not eaten.
text.WEB: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

text.KJV: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
text.ASV: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
text.WEB: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

text.KJV: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
text.ASV: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.
text.WEB: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

text.KJV: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
text.ASV: These twenty years have I been in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
text.WEB: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

text.KJV: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
text.ASV: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now hadst thou sent me away empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
text.WEB: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

text.KJV: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
text.ASV: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, and the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children whom they have borne?
text.WEB: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine: and what can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

text.KJV: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
text.ASV: And now come, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
text.WEB: Now come, let us make a covenant, you and I; and let it be for a witness between me and you.”

text.KJV: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
text.ASV: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
text.WEB: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

text.KJV: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
text.ASV: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there by the heap.
text.WEB: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

text.KJV: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
text.ASV: And Laban called it Jegar-saha-dutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
text.WEB: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

text.KJV: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
text.ASV: And Laban said, This heap is witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed:
text.WEB: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

text.KJV: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
text.ASV: and Mizpah, for he said, Jehovah watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
text.WEB: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

text.KJV: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
text.ASV: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, and if thou shalt take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
text.WEB: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

text.KJV: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:
text.ASV: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold the pillar, which I have set betwixt me and thee.
text.WEB: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

text.KJV: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
text.ASV: This heap be witness, and the pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
text.WEB: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

text.KJV: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
text.ASV: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the Fear of his father Isaac.
text.WEB: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

text.KJV: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
text.ASV: And Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mountain.
text.WEB: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

text.KJV: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
text.ASV: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed and returned unto his place.
text.WEB: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

text.KJV: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
text.ASV: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
text.WEB: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

text.KJV: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
text.ASV: And Jacob said when he saw them, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
text.WEB: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

text.KJV: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
text.ASV: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
text.WEB: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

text.KJV: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
text.ASV: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye say unto my lord Esau: Thus saith thy servant Jacob, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed until now:
text.WEB: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

text.KJV: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
text.ASV: and I have oxen, and asses, `and' flocks, and men-servants, and maid-servants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in thy sight.
text.WEB: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

text.KJV: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
text.ASV: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and moreover he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
text.WEB: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. Not only that, but he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.”

text.KJV: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
text.ASV: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed: and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;
text.WEB: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;

text.KJV: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
text.ASV: and he said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the company which is left shall escape.
text.WEB: and he said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

text.KJV: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
text.ASV: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, O Jehovah, who saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good:
text.WEB: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

text.KJV: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast showed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
text.ASV: I am not worthy of the least of all the lovingkindnesses, and of all the truth, which thou hast showed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two companies.
text.WEB: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

text.KJV: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
text.ASV: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.
text.WEB: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and strike me, and the mothers with the children.

text.KJV: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
text.ASV: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
text.WEB: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

text.KJV: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
text.ASV: And he lodged there that night, and took of that which he had with him a present for Esau his brother:
text.WEB: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him, a present for Esau, his brother:

text.KJV: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
text.ASV: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
text.WEB: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

text.KJV: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
text.ASV: thirty milch camels and their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.
text.WEB: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

text.KJV: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
text.ASV: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
text.WEB: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

text.KJV: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
text.ASV: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
text.WEB: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

text.KJV: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
text.ASV: then thou shalt say `They are' thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, he also is behind us.
text.WEB: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

text.KJV: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
text.ASV: And he commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him;
text.WEB: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.

text.KJV: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
text.ASV: and ye shall say, Moreover, behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept me.
text.WEB: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

text.KJV: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
text.ASV: So the present passed over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the company.
text.WEB: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

text.KJV: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
text.ASV: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two handmaids, and his eleven children, and passed over the ford of the Jabbok.
text.WEB: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

text.KJV: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
text.ASV: And he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
text.WEB: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

text.KJV: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
text.ASV: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
text.WEB: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.

text.KJV: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
text.ASV: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained, as he wrestled with him.
text.WEB: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained, as he wrestled.

text.KJV: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
text.ASV: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
text.WEB: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go, unless you bless me.”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
text.WEB: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.

text.KJV: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
text.ASV: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for thou hast striven with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
text.WEB: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

text.KJV: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
text.ASV: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
text.WEB: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” He blessed him there.

text.KJV: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
text.ASV: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, `said he', I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
text.WEB: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

text.KJV: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
text.ASV: And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Penuel, and he limped upon his thigh.
text.WEB: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

text.KJV: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
text.ASV: Therefore the children of Israel eat not the sinew of the hip which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew of the hip.
text.WEB: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

text.KJV: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
text.ASV: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
text.WEB: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

text.KJV: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
text.ASV: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
text.WEB: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

text.KJV: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
text.ASV: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
text.WEB: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

text.KJV: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
text.ASV: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
text.WEB: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

text.KJV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
text.ASV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are these with thee? And he said, The children whom God hath graciously given thy servant.
text.WEB: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

text.KJV: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
text.ASV: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
text.WEB: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

text.KJV: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
text.ASV: And Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
text.WEB: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

text.KJV: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
text.ASV: And he said, What meanest thou by all this company which I met? And he said, To find favor in the sight of my lord.
text.WEB: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

text.KJV: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
text.ASV: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; let that which thou hast be thine.
text.WEB: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

text.KJV: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
text.ASV: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found favor in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as I have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
text.WEB: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

text.KJV: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
text.ASV: Take, I pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
text.WEB: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

text.KJV: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
text.ASV: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
text.WEB: Esau said, “Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before you.”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young: and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
text.WEB: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

text.KJV: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
text.ASV: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
text.WEB: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

text.KJV: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
text.ASV: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find favor in the sight of my lord.
text.WEB: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the folk who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

text.KJV: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
text.ASV: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
text.WEB: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

text.KJV: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
text.ASV: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
text.WEB: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

text.KJV: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
text.ASV: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.
text.WEB: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

text.KJV: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
text.ASV: And he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.
text.WEB: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

text.KJV: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.
text.ASV: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-israel.
text.WEB: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

text.KJV: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
text.ASV: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
text.WEB: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

text.KJV: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
text.ASV: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; And he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.
text.WEB: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

text.KJV: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
text.ASV: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
text.WEB: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

text.KJV: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
text.ASV: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
text.WEB: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

text.KJV: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
text.ASV: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they came.
text.WEB: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

text.KJV: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
text.ASV: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
text.WEB: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

text.KJV: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter: which thing ought not to be done.
text.ASV: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
