text.WEB: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; a thing ought not to be done.

text.KJV: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
text.ASV: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you, give her unto him to wife.
text.WEB: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

text.KJV: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
text.ASV: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
text.WEB: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

text.KJV: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
text.ASV: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
text.WEB: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

text.KJV: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
text.ASV: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find favor in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
text.WEB: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

text.KJV: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
text.ASV: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
text.WEB: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

text.KJV: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
text.ASV: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spake, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
text.WEB: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit, and spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

text.KJV: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
text.ASV: and said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.
text.WEB: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

text.KJV: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
text.ASV: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
text.WEB: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;

text.KJV: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
text.ASV: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
text.WEB: then will we give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

text.KJV: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
text.ASV: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
text.WEB: But if you will not listen to us, to be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

text.KJV: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
text.ASV: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
text.WEB: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

text.KJV: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honorable than all the house of his father.
text.ASV: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was honored above all the house of his father.
text.WEB: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

text.KJV: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
text.ASV: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
text.WEB: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

text.KJV: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
text.ASV: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
text.WEB: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

text.KJV: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
text.ASV: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
text.WEB: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

text.KJV: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
text.ASV: Shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
text.WEB: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let us give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

text.KJV: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
text.ASV: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
text.WEB: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

text.KJV: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
text.ASV: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.
text.WEB: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

text.KJV: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
text.ASV: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went forth.
text.WEB: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

text.KJV: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
text.ASV: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
text.WEB: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

text.KJV: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
text.ASV: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field;
text.WEB: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

text.KJV: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
text.ASV: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and made a prey, even all that was in the house.
text.WEB: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

text.KJV: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
text.ASV: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and, I being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
text.WEB: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

text.KJV: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
text.ASV: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?
text.WEB: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

text.KJV: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
text.ASV: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, who appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
text.WEB: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

text.KJV: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
text.ASV: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the foreign gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your garments:
text.WEB: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, change your garments.

text.KJV: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
text.ASV: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
text.WEB: Let us arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

text.KJV: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
text.ASV: And they gave unto Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
text.WEB: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

text.KJV: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
text.ASV: And they journeyed: and a terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
text.WEB: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

text.KJV: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
text.ASV: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan (the same is Beth-el), he and all the people that were with him.
text.WEB: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

text.KJV: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
text.ASV: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el; because there God was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
text.WEB: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

text.KJV: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
text.ASV: And Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried below Beth-el under the oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bacuth.
text.WEB: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

text.KJV: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
text.ASV: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.
text.WEB: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

text.KJV: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
text.ASV: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
text.WEB: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

text.KJV: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
text.ASV: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
text.WEB: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

text.KJV: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
text.ASV: and the land which I gave unto Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
text.WEB: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you will I give the land.”

text.KJV: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
text.ASV: And God went up from him in the place where he spake with him.
text.WEB: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

text.KJV: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
text.ASV: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spake with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.
text.WEB: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

text.KJV: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
text.ASV: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.
text.WEB: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

text.KJV: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.
text.ASV: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was still some distance to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.
text.WEB: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; for now thou shalt have another son.
text.WEB: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
text.WEB: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

text.KJV: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
text.ASV: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).
text.WEB: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

text.KJV: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
text.ASV: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave: the same is the Pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
text.WEB: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

text.KJV: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
text.ASV: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
text.WEB: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
text.ASV: And it came to pass, while Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
text.WEB: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

text.KJV: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
text.ASV: The sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun;
text.WEB: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

text.KJV: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
text.ASV: the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;
text.WEB: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

text.KJV: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
text.ASV: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid: Dan and Naphtali;
text.WEB: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

text.KJV: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
text.ASV: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Paddan-aram.
text.WEB: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

text.KJV: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arba, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
text.ASV: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father to Mamre, to Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
text.WEB: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

text.KJV: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
text.ASV: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and fourscore years.
text.WEB: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

text.KJV: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
text.ASV: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days: and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
text.WEB: Isaac gave up the spirit, and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

text.KJV: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
text.ASV: Now these are the generations of Esau (the same is Edom).
text.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

text.KJV: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
text.ASV: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
text.WEB: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

text.KJV: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
text.ASV: and Basemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
text.WEB: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

text.KJV: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
text.ASV: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bare Reuel;
text.WEB: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

text.KJV: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

text.KJV: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colors.
text.ASV: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colors.
text.WEB: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a coat of many colors.

text.KJV: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
text.ASV: And his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren; and they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
text.WEB: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

text.KJV: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
text.ASV: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
text.WEB: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
text.WEB: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

text.KJV: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
text.ASV: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves came round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
text.WEB: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

text.KJV: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
text.ASV: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? Or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
text.WEB: His brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Or will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

text.KJV: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
text.ASV: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed yet a dream: and, behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars made obeisance to me.
text.WEB: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

text.KJV: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
text.ASV: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren; and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
text.WEB: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to you to the earth?”

text.KJV: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
text.ASV: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying in mind.
text.WEB: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

text.KJV: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
text.ASV: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
text.WEB: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

text.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
text.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Are not thy brethren feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
text.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

text.KJV: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
text.ASV: And he said to him, Go now, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flock; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

text.KJV: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

text.WEB: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

text.KJV: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

text.WEB: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

text.KJV: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
text.ASV: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
text.WEB: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

text.KJV: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

text.WEB: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

text.KJV: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
