text.ASV: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
text.WEB: Reuben returned to the pit; and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

text.KJV: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
text.ASV: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
text.WEB: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

text.KJV: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
text.ASV: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a he-goat, and dipped the coat in the blood;
text.WEB: They took Joseph’s coat, and killed a male goat, and dipped the coat in the blood.

text.KJV: And they sent the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
text.ASV: and they sent the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, This have we found: know now whether it is thy son's coat or not.
text.WEB: They took the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, whether it is your son’s coat or not.”

text.KJV: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
text.ASV: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat: an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.
text.WEB: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s coat. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

text.KJV: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
text.ASV: And Jacob rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
text.WEB: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

text.KJV: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
text.ASV: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.
text.WEB: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning.” His father wept for him.

text.KJV: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.
text.ASV: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard.
text.WEB: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

text.KJV: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
text.ASV: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
text.WEB: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

text.KJV: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
text.ASV: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua. And he took her, and went in unto her.
text.WEB: Judah saw there a certain Canaanite man named Shua’s daughter. He took her, and went in to her.

text.KJV: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
text.ASV: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
text.WEB: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

text.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
text.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
text.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

text.KJV: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
text.ASV: And she yet again bare a son, and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
text.WEB: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.

text.KJV: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
text.ASV: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.
text.WEB: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

text.KJV: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
text.ASV: And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah. And Jehovah slew him.
text.WEB: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. Yahweh killed him.

text.KJV: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
text.ASV: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
text.WEB: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

text.KJV: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
text.ASV: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.
text.WEB: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

text.KJV: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
text.ASV: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and he slew him also.
text.WEB: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.

text.KJV: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
text.ASV: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow in thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown up; for he said, Lest he also die, like his brethren. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
text.WEB: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up”; for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

text.KJV: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
text.ASV: And in process of time Shua's daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
text.WEB: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

text.KJV: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
text.ASV: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.
text.WEB: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

text.KJV: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
text.ASV: And she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.
text.WEB: She took off her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

text.KJV: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
text.ASV: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.
text.WEB: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

text.KJV: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
text.ASV: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Come, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee: for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
text.WEB: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

text.KJV: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
text.ASV: And he said, I will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
text.WEB: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

text.KJV: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
text.ASV: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand. And he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
text.WEB: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

text.KJV: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
text.ASV: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
text.WEB: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

text.KJV: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
text.ASV: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
text.WEB: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

text.KJV: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
text.ASV: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There hath been no prostitute here.
text.WEB: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

text.KJV: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
text.ASV: And he returned to Judah, and said, I have not found her; and also the men of the place said, There hath been no prostitute here.
text.WEB: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

text.KJV: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
text.ASV: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be put to shame: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
text.WEB: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
text.ASV: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
text.WEB: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

text.KJV: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
text.ASV: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.
text.WEB: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “By the man, whose these are, I am with child.” She also said, “Please discern whose are these—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

text.KJV: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
text.ASV: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She is more righteous than I; forasmuch as I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
text.WEB: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

text.KJV: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
text.WEB: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
text.WEB: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, Wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself? Therefore his name was called Perez.
text.WEB: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

text.KJV: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
text.ASV: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zerah.
text.WEB: Afterward his brother came out, that had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

text.KJV: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites, which had brought him down thither.
text.ASV: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither.
text.WEB: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

text.KJV: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
text.ASV: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
text.WEB: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

text.KJV: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
text.ASV: And his master saw that Jehovah was with him, and that Jehovah made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
text.WEB: His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.

text.KJV: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
text.ASV: And Joseph found favor in his sight, and he ministered unto him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
text.WEB: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

text.KJV: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
text.ASV: And it came to pass from the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that Jehovah blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of Jehovah was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.
text.WEB: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. Yahweh’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

text.KJV: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favored.
text.ASV: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not aught `that was' with him, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was comely, and well-favored.
text.WEB: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
text.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
text.WEB: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

text.KJV: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
text.ASV: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master knoweth not what is with me in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand:
text.WEB: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

text.KJV: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
text.ASV: he is not greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
text.WEB: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, `or' to be with her.
text.WEB: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

text.KJV: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
text.ASV: And it came to pass about this time, that he went into the house to do his work; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
text.WEB: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

text.KJV: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
text.ASV: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
text.WEB: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
text.WEB: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

text.KJV: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
text.ASV: that she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us: he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
text.WEB: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
text.ASV: and it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.
text.WEB: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

text.KJV: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
text.ASV: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
text.WEB: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

text.KJV: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
text.ASV: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
text.WEB: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
text.ASV: and it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.
text.WEB: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
text.WEB: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

text.KJV: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
text.ASV: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
text.WEB: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

text.KJV: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed him mercy, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
text.ASV: But Jehovah was with Joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
text.WEB: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

text.KJV: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
text.ASV: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
text.WEB: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

text.KJV: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.
text.ASV: The keeper of the prison looked not to anything that was under his hand, because Jehovah was with him; and that which he did, Jehovah made it prosper.
text.WEB: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because Yahweh was with him; and that which he did, Yahweh made it prosper.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
text.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.
text.WEB: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh was wroth against his two officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
text.WEB: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

text.KJV: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
text.ASV: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
text.WEB: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

text.KJV: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
text.ASV: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he ministered unto them: and they continued a season in ward.
text.WEB: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

text.KJV: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
text.ASV: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
text.WEB: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

text.KJV: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
text.ASV: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and saw them, and, behold, they were sad.
text.WEB: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

text.KJV: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
text.ASV: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in ward in his master's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sad to-day?
text.WEB: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

text.KJV: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
text.ASV: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell it me, I pray you.
text.WEB: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

text.KJV: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
text.ASV: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
text.WEB: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

text.KJV: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
text.ASV: and in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, `and' its blossoms shot forth; `and' the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
text.WEB: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
text.ASV: and Pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
text.WEB: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days;
text.WEB: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

text.KJV: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
text.ASV: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee unto thine office: and thou shalt give Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
text.WEB: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

text.KJV: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
text.ASV: But have me in thy remembrance when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
text.WEB: But remember me when it will be well with you, and please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

text.KJV: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
text.ASV: for indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
text.WEB: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

text.KJV: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
text.ASV: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head:
text.WEB: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

text.KJV: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
text.ASV: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of baked food for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
text.WEB: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

text.KJV: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
text.ASV: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;
text.WEB: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

text.KJV: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
text.ASV: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
text.WEB: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
text.ASV: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
text.WEB: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

text.KJV: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
text.ASV: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
text.WEB: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

text.KJV: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
text.ASV: but he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
text.WEB: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

text.KJV: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
text.ASV: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
text.WEB: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

text.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
text.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
text.WEB: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed: and behold, he stood by the river.

text.KJV: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favored kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
text.ASV: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favored and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.
text.WEB: Behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

text.KJV: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favored and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
text.ASV: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill-favored and lean-fleshed, and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
text.WEB: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

text.KJV: And the ill favored and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favored and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
text.ASV: And the ill-favored and lean-fleshed kine did eat up the seven well-favored and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
text.WEB: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

text.KJV: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
text.ASV: And he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
text.WEB: He slept and dreamed a second time: and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

text.KJV: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
text.ASV: And, behold, seven ears, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
text.WEB: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

text.KJV: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
text.ASV: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
text.WEB: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

text.KJV: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
text.WEB: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

text.KJV: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
text.ASV: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
text.WEB: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

text.KJV: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:
text.ASV: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker:
text.WEB: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

text.KJV: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
text.ASV: and we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
text.WEB: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. We dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

text.KJV: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
text.ASV: And there was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
text.WEB: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. To each man according to his dream he interpreted.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
text.WEB: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

text.KJV: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
text.ASV: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
text.WEB: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it.
text.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

text.KJV: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
text.ASV: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
text.WEB: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
text.ASV: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the brink of the river:
text.WEB: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river:

text.KJV: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favored; and they fed in a meadow:
text.ASV: and, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and well-favored: and they fed in the reed-grass:
text.WEB: and behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, fat and sleek. They fed in the marsh grass,

text.KJV: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favored and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
text.ASV: and, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill-favored and lean-fleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
text.WEB: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

text.KJV: And the lean and the ill favored kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
text.ASV: and the lean and ill-favored kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
text.WEB: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle,

text.KJV: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favored, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
text.ASV: and when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill-favored, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
text.WEB: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

text.KJV: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
text.ASV: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good:
text.WEB: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good:

text.KJV: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
text.ASV: and, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, `and' blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
text.WEB: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

text.KJV: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
text.ASV: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears: and I told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
text.WEB: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath showed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: what God is about to do he hath declared unto Pharaoh.
text.WEB: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

text.KJV: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
text.ASV: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
text.WEB: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

text.KJV: And the seven thin and ill favored kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
text.ASV: And the seven lean and ill-favored kine that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind; they shall be seven years of famine.
text.WEB: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

text.KJV: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he showeth unto Pharaoh.
text.ASV: That is the thing which I spake unto Pharaoh: what God is about to do he hath showed unto Pharaoh.
text.WEB: That is the thing which I spoke to Pharaoh. What God is about to do he has shown to Pharaoh.

text.KJV: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
text.ASV: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
text.WEB: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
text.ASV: and there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
text.WEB: There will arise after them seven years of famine, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

text.KJV: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
text.ASV: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.
text.WEB: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

text.KJV: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
text.ASV: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh, it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
text.WEB: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

text.KJV: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
text.ASV: Let Pharaoh do `this', and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
text.WEB: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

text.KJV: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
text.ASV: And let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
text.WEB: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

text.KJV: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
text.ASV: And the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
text.WEB: The food will be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; that the land not perish through the famine.”

text.KJV: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
text.ASV: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
text.WEB: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the spirit of God is?
text.WEB: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath showed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath showed thee all of this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou:
text.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

text.KJV: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
text.ASV: thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
text.WEB: You shall be over my house, and according to your word will all my people be ruled. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
text.ASV: And Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
text.WEB: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck,

text.KJV: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he set him over all the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
text.ASV: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
text.WEB: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

text.KJV: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
text.ASV: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
text.WEB: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was around every city, he laid up in the same.

text.KJV: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
text.ASV: And Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left off numbering; for it was without number.
text.WEB: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

text.KJV: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
text.ASV: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bare unto him.
text.WEB: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

text.KJV: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
text.ASV: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh: For, `said he', God hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
text.WEB: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

text.KJV: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
text.ASV: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.
text.WEB: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

text.KJV: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
text.ASV: And the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
text.WEB: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

text.KJV: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
text.ASV: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said: and there was famine in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
text.WEB: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

text.KJV: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

text.KJV: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
text.ASV: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
text.WEB: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

text.KJV: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

text.ASV: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
text.WEB: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

text.KJV: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
text.ASV: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
text.WEB: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
text.WEB: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

text.KJV: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

text.ASV: hereby ye shall be proved: by the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

text.KJV: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
text.ASV: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be bound, that your words may be proved, whether there be truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

text.KJV: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
text.ASV: and bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
text.WEB: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.

text.ASV: and bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffic in the land.

text.KJV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

text.KJV: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
text.ASV: And Joseph made haste; for his heart yearned over his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

text.KJV: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
text.ASV: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, that did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
text.WEB: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians, that ate with him, by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat bread with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

text.KJV: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marveled one at another.
text.ASV: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one with another.
text.WEB: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled one with another.

text.KJV: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
text.ASV: And he took `and sent' messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
text.WEB: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.

text.KJV: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
text.ASV: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
text.WEB: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

text.KJV: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
text.ASV: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his grain money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
text.WEB: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

text.KJV: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
text.ASV: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
text.WEB: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

text.KJV: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
text.ASV: `And' when they were gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
text.WEB: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

text.KJV: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
text.ASV: Is not this that in which my lord drinketh, and whereby he indeed divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
text.WEB: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

text.KJV: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
text.ASV: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these words.
text.WEB: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

text.KJV: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
text.ASV: And they said unto him, Wherefore speaketh my lord such words as these? Far be it from thy servants that they should do such a thing.
text.WEB: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

text.KJV: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
text.ASV: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
text.WEB: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

text.KJV: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
text.ASV: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
text.WEB: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

text.KJV: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
text.ASV: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my bondman; and ye shall be blameless.
text.WEB: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words: he with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

text.KJV: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
text.ASV: Then they hasted, and took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
text.WEB: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

text.KJV: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
text.ASV: And he searched, `and' began at the eldest, and left off at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

text.KJV: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
text.ASV: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
text.WEB: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

text.KJV: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
text.ASV: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; and he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
text.WEB: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? know ye not that such a man as I can indeed divine?
text.WEB: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed divine?”

text.KJV: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
text.ASV: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's bondmen, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.
text.WEB: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? Or how will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

text.KJV: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
text.ASV: And he said, Far be it from me that I should do so: the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my bondman; but as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
text.WEB: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

text.KJV: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
text.ASV: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh, my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant; for thou art even as Pharaoh.
text.WEB: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

text.KJV: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
text.ASV: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
text.WEB: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

text.KJV: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
text.ASV: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loveth him.
text.WEB: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

text.KJV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
text.ASV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
text.WEB: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

text.KJV: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
text.ASV: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
text.WEB: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

text.KJV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
text.ASV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
text.WEB: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

text.KJV: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
text.ASV: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
text.WEB: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

text.KJV: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
text.ASV: And our father said, Go again, buy us a little food.
text.WEB: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

text.KJV: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
text.ASV: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, expect our youngest brother be with us.
text.WEB: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

text.KJV: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
text.ASV: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
text.WEB: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons:

text.KJV: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
text.ASV: and the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I have not seen him since:
text.WEB: and the one went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces”; and I haven’t seen him since.

text.KJV: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
text.ASV: and if ye take this one also from me, and harm befall him, ye will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.
text.WEB: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

text.KJV: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
text.ASV: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad is not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
text.WEB: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

text.KJV: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
text.ASV: it will come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not `with us', that he will die: and thy servants will bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to Sheol.
text.WEB: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

text.KJV: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
text.ASV: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then shall I bear the blame to my father for ever.
text.WEB: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

text.KJV: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
text.ASV: Now therefore, let thy servant, I pray thee, abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
text.WEB: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

text.KJV: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
text.ASV: For how shall I go up to my father, if the lad be not with me? lest I see the evil that shall come on my father.
text.WEB: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

text.KJV: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
text.ASV: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood before him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
text.WEB: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he cried, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

text.KJV: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
text.ASV: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
text.WEB: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
text.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
text.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. “He said, I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

text.KJV: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
text.ASV: And now be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
text.WEB: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

text.KJV: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
text.ASV: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither plowing nor harvest.
text.WEB: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

text.KJV: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
text.ASV: And God sent me before you to preserve you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
text.WEB: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

text.KJV: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
