text.WEB: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
text.ASV: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not;
text.WEB: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

text.KJV: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
text.ASV: and thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
text.WEB: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

text.KJV: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
text.ASV: and there will I nourish thee; for there are yet five years of famine; lest thou come to poverty, thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast.
text.WEB: There I will nourish you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

text.KJV: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
text.ASV: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
text.WEB: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

text.KJV: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
text.ASV: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen: and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
text.WEB: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

text.KJV: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
text.ASV: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
text.WEB: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

text.KJV: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
text.ASV: And he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
text.WEB: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

text.KJV: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
text.ASV: And the report thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
text.WEB: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye: lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
text.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this. Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
text.ASV: and take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
text.WEB: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

text.KJV: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
text.ASV: Now thou art commanded, this do ye: take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
text.WEB: Now you are commanded: do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

text.KJV: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
text.ASV: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
text.WEB: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”

text.KJV: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

text.KJV: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

text.KJV: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

text.KJV: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
text.WEB: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

text.KJV: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
text.ASV: that ye shall say, Thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
text.WEB: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

text.KJV: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

text.ASV: And from among his brethren he took five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
text.WEB: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

text.WEB: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

text.KJV: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
text.ASV: And they said unto Pharaoh, To sojourn in the land are we come; for there is no pasture for thy servants' flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

text.KJV: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
text.ASV: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
text.WEB: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

text.WEB: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

text.ASV: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

text.KJV: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

text.KJV: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

text.KJV: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
text.ASV: but when I sleep with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying-place. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
text.WEB: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” He said, “I will do as you have said.”

text.KJV: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
text.ASV: And he said, Swear unto me: and he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
text.WEB: He said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

text.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
text.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that one said to Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
text.WEB: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

text.KJV: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
text.ASV: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
text.WEB: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

text.KJV: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
text.ASV: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
text.WEB: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

text.KJV: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
text.ASV: and said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a company of peoples, and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
text.WEB: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’

text.KJV: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
text.ASV: And now thy two sons, who were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, shall be mine.
text.WEB: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

text.KJV: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
text.ASV: And thy issue, that thou begettest after them, shall be thine; they shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
text.WEB: Your issue, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

text.KJV: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
text.ASV: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when there was still some distance to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).
text.WEB: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”

text.KJV: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
text.ASV: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
text.WEB: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me here. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
text.WEB: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

text.KJV: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
text.ASV: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
text.WEB: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see. He brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

text.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath showed me also thy seed.
text.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath let me see thy seed also.
text.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”

text.KJV: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
text.ASV: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
text.WEB: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

text.KJV: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
text.ASV: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
text.WEB: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

text.KJV: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
text.ASV: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the first-born.
text.WEB: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

text.KJV: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
text.ASV: And he blessed Joseph, and said, The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God who hath fed me all my life long unto this day,
text.WEB: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

text.KJV: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
text.ASV: the angel who hath redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
text.WEB: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”

text.KJV: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
text.ASV: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
text.WEB: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father; for this is the first-born; put thy right hand upon his head.
text.WEB: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father; for this is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”

text.KJV: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
text.ASV: And his father refused, and said, I know `it', my son, I know `it'. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: howbeit his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
text.WEB: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”

text.KJV: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
text.ASV: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee will Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
text.WEB: He blessed them that day, saying, “In you will Israel bless, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

text.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
text.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God will be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
text.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

text.KJV: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
text.ASV: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
text.WEB: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

text.KJV: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
text.ASV: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said: gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the latter days.
text.WEB: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

text.KJV: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
text.ASV: Assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; And hearken unto Israel your father.
text.WEB: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

text.KJV: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
text.ASV: Reuben, thou art my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength; The pre-eminence of dignity, and the pre-eminence of power.
text.WEB: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

text.KJV: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
text.ASV: Boiling over as water, thou shalt not have the pre-eminence; Because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; Then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
text.WEB: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

text.KJV: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
text.ASV: Simeon and Levi are brethren; Weapons of violence are their swords.
text.WEB: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

text.KJV: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honor, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their self-will they digged down a wall.
text.ASV: O my soul, come not thou into their council; Unto their assembly, my glory, be not thou united; For in their anger they slew a man, And in their self-will they hocked an ox.
text.WEB: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

text.KJV: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
text.ASV: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; And their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, And scatter them in Israel.
text.WEB: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

text.KJV: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
text.ASV: Judah, thee shall thy brethren praise: Thy hand shall be on the neck of thine enemies; Thy father's sons shall bow down before thee.
text.WEB: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

text.KJV: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
text.ASV: Judah is a lion's whelp; From the prey, my son, thou art gone up: He stooped down, he couched as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up?
text.WEB: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

text.KJV: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
text.ASV: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, Nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, Until Shiloh come: And unto him shall the obedience of the peoples be.
text.WEB: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.

text.KJV: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
text.ASV: Binding his foal unto the vine, And his ass's colt unto the choice vine; He hath washed his garments in wine, And his vesture in the blood of grapes:
text.WEB: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

text.KJV: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
text.ASV: His eyes shall be red with wine, And his teeth white with milk.
text.WEB: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

text.KJV: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
text.ASV: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; And he shall be for a haven of ships; And his border shall be upon Sidon.
text.WEB: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

text.KJV: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
text.ASV: Issachar is a strong ass, Couching down between the sheepfolds:
text.WEB: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

text.KJV: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
text.ASV: And he saw a resting-place that it was good, And the land that it was pleasant; And he bowed his shoulder to bear, And became a servant under taskwork.
text.WEB: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

text.KJV: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
text.ASV: Dan shall judge his people, As one of the tribes of Israel.
text.WEB: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

text.KJV: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
text.ASV: Dan shall be a serpent in the way, An adder in the path, That biteth the horse's heels, So that his rider falleth backward.
text.WEB: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

text.KJV: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
text.ASV: I have waited for thy salvation, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
text.ASV: Gad, a troop shall press upon him; But he shall press upon their heel.
text.WEB: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

text.KJV: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
text.ASV: Out of the Asher his bread shall be fat, And he shall yield royal dainties.
text.WEB: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

text.KJV: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
text.ASV: Naphtali is a hind let loose: He giveth goodly words.
text.WEB: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

text.KJV: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
text.ASV: Joseph is a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a fountain; His branches run over the wall.
text.WEB: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

text.KJV: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
text.ASV: The archers have sorely grieved him, And shot at him, and persecute him:
text.WEB: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

text.KJV: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
text.ASV: But his bow abode in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong, By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (From thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
text.WEB: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

text.KJV: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
text.ASV: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee, And by the Almighty, who shall bless thee, With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that coucheth beneath, Blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
text.WEB: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

text.KJV: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
text.ASV: The blessings of thy father Have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors Unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
text.WEB: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

text.KJV: Benjamin shall raven as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
text.ASV: Benjamin is a wolf that raveneth: In the morning she shall devour the prey, And at even he shall divide the spoil.
text.WEB: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

text.KJV: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
text.ASV: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
text.WEB: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.

text.KJV: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
text.ASV: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
text.WEB: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

text.KJV: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
text.ASV: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a burying-place.
text.WEB: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

text.KJV: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
text.ASV: there they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah:
text.WEB: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

text.KJV: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
text.ASV: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.
text.WEB: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

text.KJV: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
text.ASV: And when Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
text.WEB: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.

text.KJV: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
text.ASV: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
text.WEB: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

text.KJV: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
text.ASV: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
text.WEB: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

text.KJV: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
text.ASV: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of embalming: and the Egyptians wept for him three-score and ten days.
text.WEB: Forty days were fulfilled for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for him for seventy days.

text.KJV: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
text.ASV: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found favor in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
text.WEB: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

text.KJV: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
text.ASV: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
text.WEB: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

text.KJV: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
text.ASV: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
text.WEB: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

text.KJV: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
text.ASV: And Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
text.WEB: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

text.KJV: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
text.ASV: and all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
text.WEB: All the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

text.KJV: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
text.ASV: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
text.WEB: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.

text.KJV: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
text.ASV: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
text.WEB: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

text.KJV: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
text.ASV: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
text.WEB: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

text.KJV: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
text.ASV: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
text.WEB: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

text.KJV: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
text.ASV: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burying-place, of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
text.WEB: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.

text.KJV: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
text.ASV: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
text.WEB: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

text.KJV: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
text.ASV: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
text.WEB: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”

text.KJV: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
text.ASV: And they sent a message unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
text.WEB: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

text.KJV: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
text.ASV: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin, for that they did unto thee evil. And now, we pray thee, forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
text.WEB: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

text.KJV: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
text.ASV: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we are thy servants.
text.WEB: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
text.WEB: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

text.KJV: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
text.ASV: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
text.WEB: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.

text.KJV: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
text.ASV: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
text.WEB: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will nourish you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

text.KJV: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
text.ASV: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.
text.WEB: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

text.KJV: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
text.ASV: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were born upon Joseph's knees.
text.WEB: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

text.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
text.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die; but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
text.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

text.KJV: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
text.ASV: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
text.WEB: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

text.KJV: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
text.ASV: So Joseph died, being a hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
text.WEB: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
